t: Chapter on the Beneficiary of a Bequest Dying Before the Testator or Before Receiving What Was Bequeathed to Him
ar: 5488 - روي عمرو بن سعيد المدايني عن محمد بن عمر الساباطي قال : سالت ابا جعفر يعني الثاني عليه السلام عن رجل اوصي الي و امرني ان اعطي عما له في كل سنه شييا فمات العم فكتب عليه السلام "اعط ورثته".
en:
Hadith.5488 - Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini narrated from Muhammad ibn Umar Al-Sabati who said: I asked Abu Ja'far Al-Thani (as), (the second (as)), about a man who had appointed me as his executor and instructed to give something to his uncle every year. The uncle then passed away.
Abu Jafar (as) wrote in response: "Give it to his heirs."

t: Chapter on the Beneficiary of a Bequest Dying Before the Testator or Before Receiving What Was Bequeathed to Him
ar: 5489 - و روي عاصم بن حميد عن محمد بن قيس عن ابي جعفر الباقر عليه السلام قال : "قضي امير المومنين عليه السلام في رجل اوصي لاخر و الموصي له غايب فتوفي الذي اوصي له قبل الموصي قال "الوصيه لوارث الذي اوصي له" و قال عليه السلام "من اوصي لاحد شاهد او غايب فتوفي الموصي له قبل الموصي فالوصيه لوارث الذي اوصي له الا ان يرجع في وصيته قبل ان يموت" ".
en:
Hadith.5489 - Asim ibn Humaid narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled concerning a man who made a bequest to another, but the person to whom the bequest was made was absent and died before the one who made the bequest.
Imam (as) said: 'The bequest is for the heir of the one to whom it was made.'
Imam (as) also said: 'Whoever makes a bequest to someone, whether present or absent, and the beneficiary dies before the one who made the bequest, then the bequest goes to the heir of the beneficiary, unless the testator revokes the bequest before his own death.'"

t: Chapter on the Beneficiary of a Bequest Dying Before the Testator or Before Receiving What Was Bequeathed to Him
ar: 5490 - و روي العباس بن عامر عن مثني قال : سالته عن رجل اوصي له بوصيه فمات قبل ان يقبضها و لم يترك عقبا قال "اطلب له وارثا او مولي فادفعها اليه" قلت فان لم يعلم له ولي قال "اجهد ان تقدر له علي ولي فان لم تجده و علم الله عز و جل منك الجهد فتصدق بها".
en:
Hadith.5490 - Al-Abbas ibn Amir narrated from Muthanna who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man for whom a bequest was made, but he died before receiving it and left no offspring.
Imam (as) said: "Seek an heir or his mawla (guardian) and give it to him."
I asked: "What if no heir is known?"
Imam (as) replied: "Exert yourself in searching for an heir for him, and if you cannot find one and Allah (swt), the Exalted, knows of your sincere effort, then give it in charity."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5491 - روي محمد بن ابي عمير عن معاويه بن عمار قال : اوصت الي امراه من اهل بيتي بمالها و امرت ان يعتق عنها و يحج و يتصدق فلم يبلغ ذلك فسالت ابا حنيفه فقال يجعل ذلك اثلاثا ثلثا في الحج و ثلثا في العتق و ثلثا في الصدقه فدخلت علي ابي عبد الله عليه السلام فقلت له ان امراه من اهلي ماتت و اوصت الي بثلث مالها و امرت ان يعتق عنها و يحج عنها و يتصدق عنها فنظرت فيه فلم يبلغ فقال عليه السلام "ابدا بالحج فانه فريضه من فرايض الله عز و جل و اجعل ما بقي طايفه في العتق و طايفه في الصدقه" فاخبرت ابا حنيفه بقول ابي عبد الله عليه السلام فرجع عن قوله و قال بقول ابي عبد الله عليه السلام.
en:
Hadith.5491 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muawiyah ibn Ammar who said:
A woman from my family entrusted me with her wealth and instructed that emancipation (of slaves) be made on her behalf, that Hajj be performed, and that charity be given. However, the amount left was insufficient to cover all that.
I consulted Abu Hanifah, and he said: "It should be divided into three parts - one-third for Hajj, one-third for emancipation, and one-third for charity."
Then I went to Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) and said to him:
"A woman from my family passed away and entrusted me with one-third of her wealth, instructing that Hajj be performed on her behalf, emancipation be made, and charity be given. But the amount was not enough to fulfill all these."
Imam (as) said: "Start with Hajj, for it is an obligation from the obligations of Allah (swt), the Exalted. Then divide what remains - part of it for emancipation and part for charity."
I informed Abu Hanifah of the statement of Abu Abdullah (as), and he withdrew his previous opinion and accepted the guidance of Abu Abdullah (as).

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5492 - و روي الحسن بن علي بن فضال عن داود بن فرقد قال : سيل ابو عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل كان في سفر و معه جاريه له و غلامان مملوكان فقال لهما انتما احرار لوجه الله فاشهدا ان ما في بطن جاريتي هذه مني فولدت غلاما فلما قدموا علي الورثه انكروا ذلك و استرقوهم ثم ان الغلامين اعتقا بعد فشهدا بعد ما اعتقا ان موليهما الاول اشهدهما ان ما في بطن جاريته منه قال "تجوز شهادتهما للغلام و لا يسترقهما الغلام الذي شهدا له لانهما اثبتا نسبه".
en:
Hadith.5492 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated from Dawud ibn Farqad who said:
Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a man who was on a journey with a female slave and two male servant slaves. The man said to the two male slaves, "You both are free for the sake of Allah (swt). Bear witness that what is in the womb of this bondwoman is from me."
Later, the bondwoman gave birth to a boy. When they returned to the man's heirs, the heirs denied the claim and enslaved the boy and the two male servants. Afterward, the two male slaves were emancipated, and after their emancipation, they testified that their former master had made them witness that the child in the womb of the bondwoman was indeed his child.
Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq (as) said: "Their testimony is valid in favor of the boy, and the boy cannot enslave them because they have established his lineage."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5493 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن ابي جميله عن حمران عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام : في رجل اوصي عند موته و قال اعتق فلانا و فلانا و فلانا حتي ذكر خمسه فنظر في ثلثه فلم يبلغ ثلثه اثمان قيمه المماليك الخمسه الذين امر بعتقهم قال "ينظر الي الذين سماهم و بدا بعتقهم فيقومون و ينظر الي ثلثه فيعتق منه اول شيء ذكر ثم الثاني و الثالث ثم الرابع ثم الخامس فان عجز الثلث كان في الذي سمي اخرا لانه اعتق بعد مبلغ الثلث بما لا يملك فلا يجوز له ذلك".
en:
Hadith.5493 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Jamilah from Humran from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who, on his deathbed, made a will saying, "Free so-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so," until he mentioned five individuals. When his estate was assessed, it was found that one-third of his wealth was not enough to cover the value of the five slaves he had ordered to be freed.
Imam (as) said: "The individuals he named should be evaluated according to their order of mention, starting with the first. They should be valued, and their emancipation should proceed from the first he mentioned, then the second, the third, the fourth, and finally the fifth. If the one-third of the estate runs out before reaching the last, then the last named does not get freed because the man ordered their emancipation beyond the limit of what he lawfully owned, and thus it is not permissible."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5494 - و روي العلاء بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : سالته عن رجل حضره الموت فاعتق غلامه و اوصي بوصيه فكان اكثر من الثلث قال "يمضي عتق الغلام و يكون النقصان فيما بقي".
en:
Hadith.5494 - Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who, when death approached him, freed his slave and made a will, but the total of his bequests exceeded one-third of his estate.
Imam (as) replied: "The emancipation of the slave is to be carried out, and any reduction should be applied to what remains (of the bequests beyond the one-third limit)."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5495 - و روي احمد بن محمد بن عيسي عن ابي همام اسماعيل بن همام عن ابي الحسن عليه السلام : في رجل اوصي عند موته بمال لذوي قرابته و اعتق مملوكا فكان جميع ما اوصي به يزيد علي الثلث كيف يصنع في وصيته فقال "يبدا بالعتق فينفذ".
en:
Hadith.5495 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Abu Hammam Ismail ibn Hammam from Abu Al-Hasan (as) regarding a man who, at the time of his death, made a will bequeathing wealth to his relatives and also freed a slave. However, the total of what he bequeathed exceeded one-third of his estate. He was asked how this should be handled concerning his will.
Imam (as) replied: "The emancipation (of the slave) should be carried out first."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5496 - و روي النضر بن شعيب عن خالد بن ماد عن الجازي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في رجل توفي فترك جاريه اعتق ثلثها فتزوجها الوصي قبل ان يقسم شيء من الميراث "انها تقوم و تستسعي هي و زوجها في بقيه ثمنها بعد ما تقوم فما اصاب المراه من عتق او رق جري علي ولدها".
en:
Hadith.5496 - Al-Nadr ibn Shuayb narrated from Khalid ibn Maad from Al-Jazi from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind a slave woman of whom he had freed one-third. The executor of his will married her before any division of the inheritance had taken place.
Imam (as) said: "She should be appraised (for her full value), and both she and her husband must work to pay off the remaining value of her price after her appraisal. Whatever state - whether freedom or servitude - applies to the woman will also apply to her children."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5497 - و روي احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي عن احمد بن زياد قال : سالت ابا الحسن عليه السلام عن الرجل تحضره الوفاه و له مماليك لخاصه نفسه و مماليك في الشركه مع رجل اخر فيوصي في وصيته مماليكي احرار ما خلا مماليكي الذين في الشركه فكتب عليه السلام "يقومون عليه ان كان ماله يحتمل ثم هم احرار".
en:
Hadith.5497 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti narrated from Ahmad ibn Ziyad who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (as) about a man who was on his deathbed and had slaves solely for himself and others jointly owned with another person. In his will, he stated, "My slaves are free, except for those who are in partnership."
Imam (as) wrote in response: "They should be appraised against his estate, and if his wealth can cover it, then they are free."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5498 - و روي محمد بن اسماعيل بن بزيع عن علي بن النعمان عن سويد القلاء عن ايوب بن الحر عن ابي بكر الحضرمي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : قلت له ان علقمه بن محمد اوصي ان اعتق عنه رقبه فاعتقت عنه امراه ا فتجزيه او اعتق عنه من مالي قال "يجزيه" ثم قال "ان فاطمه ام ابني اوصت ان اعتق عنها رقبه فاعتقت عنها امراه".
en:
Hadith.5498 - Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ narrated from Ali ibn Al-Nuʿman, from Suwayd Al-Qallaʾ, from Ayyub ibn Al-Hurr, from Abu Bakr Al-Haḍrami, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as), "Alqamah ibn Muhammad instructed me in his will to free a slave on his behalf, so I freed a female slave for him. Is that sufficient, or should I free another from my own wealth?"
Imam (as) replied: "It suffices him." Then Imam (as) added, "Indeed, Faṭimah, the mother of my son, had instructed me to free a slave on her behalf, so I freed a female slave for her."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5499 - و روي معاويه بن عمار عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : سالته عن رجل مات و اوصي ان يحج عنه قال "ان كان صروره حج عنه من وسط المال و ان كان غير صروره فمن الثلث".
en:
Hadith.5499 - Muawiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who died and had instructed that Hajj be performed on his behalf. Imam (as) replied: "If he had never performed Hajj (was a ṣarurah), then Hajj should be performed on his behalf from the middle of his wealth. But if he was not a ṣarurah, then it should be performed from one-third of his wealth."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5500 - و قال : في امراه اوصت بمال في عتق و حج و صدقه فلم يبلغ قال "ابدا بالحج فانه مفروض فان بقي شيء فاجعل في الصدقه طايفه و في العتق طايفه".
en: Hadith.5500 - And Imam (as) said regarding a woman who bequeathed her wealth for emancipation (freeing slaves), performing Hajj, and giving charity, but her wealth was insufficient: "Begin with Hajj because it is an obligation. If anything remains, allocate a portion for charity and a portion for emancipation."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5501 - و روي ابن ابي عمير عن علي بن ابي حمزه قال : سالت ابا الحسن عليه السلام عن رجل اوصي بثلاثين دينارا يعتق بها رجل من اصحابنا فلم يوجد بذلك قال "يشتري من الناس فيعتق".
en:
Hadith.5501 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (as) about a man who bequeathed thirty dinar for the emancipation of a man from among our companions, but no such person was found.
Imam (as) said: "A person should be purchased from among the people and then emancipated."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5502 - و روي علي بن ابي حمزه عنه انه قال : "فليشتروا من عرض الناس ما لم يكن ناصبيا ".
en: Hadith.5502 - Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated from Imam (as) that he said: "Then let them purchase from among the general people as long as he is not a Naṣibi (one who harbors enmity towards the Ahl Al-Bayt (as))."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5503 - و روي ابان بن عثمان عن محمد بن مروان عن الشيخ يعني موسي بن جعفر عن ابيه ع انه قال : "ان ابا جعفر عليه السلام مات و ترك ستين مملوكا فاعتق ثلثهم فاقرعت بينهم و اعتقت الثلث".
en:
Hadith.5503 - Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Muhammad ibn Marwan from the Shaykh, meaning Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), from his father, Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), peace be upon them both, that Imam (as) said:
"Indeed, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), passed away and left sixty servants. He freed one-third of them, then I drew lots among the remaining ones and freed another one-third."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5504 - و روي القاسم محمد الجوهري عن علي بن ابي حمزه عن ابي بصير قال : سالت ابا جعفر عليه السلام عن محرره كان اعتقها اخي و قد كانت تخدم الجواري و كانت في عياله فاوصاني ان انفق عليها من الوسط فقال "ان كانت مع الجواري و اقامت عليهم فانفق عليها و اتبع وصيته".
en:
Hadith.5504 - Al-Qasim Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said: I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), about a freed woman whom my brother had emancipated. She used to serve the maidservants and was living among his family. He had instructed me to spend on her moderately.
Abu Jafar (as), said: "If she remained with the maidservants and continued serving them, then spend on her and follow his will."

t: Chapter on Bequests for Manumission, Charity, and Hajj
ar: 5505 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن ابي ايوب عن سماعه قال : سالت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل اوصي ان يعتق عنه نسمه من ثلثه بخمسمايه درهم فاشتري الوصي نسمه باقل من خمسمايه درهم و فضلت فضله فما تري في الفضله قال "تدفع الي النسمه من قبل ان تعتق ثم تعتق عن الميت".
en:
Hadith.5505 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who had made a will that a soul be freed on his behalf from one-third of his wealth with five hundred dirhams. The executor of the will bought a soul for less than five hundred, and some amount remained. What do you say about the remaining amount?
Imam (as) said: "It should be given to the purchased soul before it is freed, and then it should be freed on behalf of the deceased."

t: Chapter on Bequests for the Mukatab and Umm Al-Walad
ar: 5506 - روي عاصم بن حميد عن محمد بن قيس عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال : "قضي امير المومنين عليه السلام في مكاتب كانت تحته امراه حره فاوصت له عند موتها بوصيه فقال "اهل الميراث لا تجوز وصيتها له انه مكاتب لم يعتق" فقضي عليه السلام "انه يرث بحساب ما اعتق منه و يجوز له من الوصيه بحساب ما اعتق منه" و قضي عليه السلام في مكاتب اوصي له بوصيه و قد قضي نصف ما عليه فاجاز له نصف الوصيه و قضي في مكاتب قضي ربع ما عليه فاوصي له بوصيه فاجاز له ربع الوصيه و قال عليه السلام في رجل اوصي لمكاتبته و قد قضت سدس ما كان عليها فاجاز لها بحساب ما اعتق منها".
en:
Hadith.5506 - Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful (as), peace be upon him, ruled concerning a contracted slave (mukatab) who was married to a free woman. She made a bequest for him at the time of her death.
Imam (as) said: 'The people entitled to inheritance cannot have her will executed for him because he is a mukatab who has not been freed.'
Then Imam (as), peace be upon him, ruled that he would inherit in proportion to what had been freed of him and that the will for him would be valid in proportion to what had been freed of him."
Imam (as) also ruled regarding a mukatab for whom a will had been made, and he had paid half of what was due upon him, that half of the will was valid for him.
Imam (as) also ruled regarding a mukatab who had paid a quarter of what was due upon him and for whom a will had been made, that a quarter of the will was valid for him.
Imam (as) said about a man who made a will for his female mukatabah and she had paid one-sixth of what was due upon her, that the will was valid for her in proportion to what had been freed of her.

t: Chapter on Bequests for the Mukatab and Umm Al-Walad
ar: 5507 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن جميل بن صالح عن ابي عبيده قال : سالت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل كانت له ام ولد و له منها غلام فلما حضرته الوفاه اوصي لها بالفي درهم او باكثر للورثه ان يسترقوها فقال "لا بل تعتق من ثلث الميت و تعطي ما اوصي لها به".
en:
Hadith.5507 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih from Abu Ubaydah, who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who had a slave woman with whom he had a son. When death approached him, he bequeathed for her two thousand dirhams or more and instructed his heirs to enslave her.
Imam (as) said: "No, rather she should be freed from one-third of the deceased's estate and given what he had bequeathed for her."

t: Chapter on Bequests for the Mukatab and Umm Al-Walad
ar: 5508 - و روي عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي قال : نسخت من كتاب بخط ابي الحسن عليه السلام فلان مولاك توفي ابن اخ له فترك ام ولد له ليس لها ولد و اوصي لها بالف درهم هل تجوز الوصيه و هل يقع عليها عتق و ما حالها رايك فدتك نفسي في ذلك فكتب عليه السلام "تعتق من الثلث و لها الوصيه".
en:
Hadith.5508 - It was narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, who said:
I copied from a book in the handwriting of Abu Al-Hasan (as):
"A certain person, your master, passed away, leaving behind a paternal nephew who also passed away. The nephew left behind an umm walad (a concubine who bore him no children) and bequeathed to her a thousand dirhams. Does the bequest hold validity, and does she receive emancipation? What is her status? May I be your ransom, I seek your opinion on this matter."
Imam (as) wrote back: "She is to be freed from one-third (of the estate), and she has the bequest."

t: Chapter on a Man Making a Bequest of a Sword, a Chest, or a Ship to Another Man
ar: 5509 - روي احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن ابي جميله عن الرضا عليه السلام قال : سالته عن رجل اوصي لرجل بسيف و كان في جفن و عليه حليه فقال له الورثه انما لك النصل و ليس لك السيف فقال "لا بل السيف بما فيه له" قال قلت له رجل اوصي بصندوق لرجل و كان فيه مال فقال الورثه انما لك الصندوق و ليس لك المال فقال "الصندوق بما فيه له".
en:
Hadith.5509 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr narrated from Abu Jamilah from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as), who said:
I asked him about a man who bequeathed a sword to another man, and the sword was in its sheath and adorned with decorations. The heirs said to him, "Only the blade belongs to you, not the sword (with its accessories)."
Imam (as) said: "No, rather the sword with everything it contains belongs to him."
I said to Imam (as): "A man bequeathed a box to another man, and there was money inside it. The heirs said: 'Only the box belongs to you, not the money.'"
Imam (as) said: "The box with everything it contains belongs to him."

t: Chapter on a Man Making a Bequest of a Sword, a Chest, or a Ship to Another Man
ar: 5510 - و روي محمد بن الحسين عن محمد بن عبد الله بن هلال عن عقبه بن خالد عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : سالته عن رجل قال هذه السفينه لفلان و لم يسم ما فيها و فيها طعام ا يعطاها الرجل و ما فيها قال "هي للذي اوصي له بها الا ان يكون صاحبها استثني ما فيها و ليس للورثه شيء ".
en:
Hadith.5510 - Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal from Uqbah ibn Khalid from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: I asked Imam (as) about a man who said:
"This ship belongs to so-and-so," without specifying what was inside it, and there was food in it. Should the man be given the ship and what is inside it?
Imam (as) said: "It belongs to the one to whom it was bequeathed, unless its owner explicitly excluded what was inside it. The heirs have no claim over it."

t: Chapter on One Who Does Not Make a Bequest While Having Heirs, if His Estate Divided Among Them or Sold for Their Benefit
ar: 5511 - روي زرعه عن سماعه قال : سالته عن رجل مات و له بنون و بنات صغار و كبار من غير وصيه و له خدم و مماليك و عقد كيف يصنع الورثه بقسمه ذلك الميراث قال "ان قام رجل ثقه قاسمهم ذلك كله فلا باس".
en:
Hadith.5511 - Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said: I asked Imam (as) about a man who died and left behind sons and daughters, both young and old, without leaving a will. He also had servants, slaves, and jewelry. How should the heirs divide that inheritance?
Imam (as) said: "If a trustworthy man undertakes the division of all that among them, then there is no harm in it."

t: Chapter on One Who Does Not Make a Bequest While Having Heirs, if His Estate Divided Among Them or Sold for Their Benefit
ar: 5512 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن علي بن رياب قال : سالت ابا الحسن موسي عليه السلام عن رجل بيني و بينه قرابه مات و ترك اولادا صغارا و ترك مماليك له غلمانا و جواري و لم يوص فما تري فيمن يشتري منهم الجاريه فيتخذها ام ولد و ما تري في بيعهم فقال "ان كان لهم ولي يقوم بامرهم باع عليهم و نظر لهم كان ماجورا فيهم" قلت فما تري فيمن يشتري منهم الجاريه فيتخذها ام ولد قال "لا باس بذلك اذا باع عليهم القيم لهم الناظر فيما يصلحهم و ليس لهم ان يرجعوا عما صنع القيم لهم الناظر فيما يصلحهم".
en:
Hadith.5512 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), about a man related to me who died and left behind young children and male and female slaves. He did not leave a will.
What is your opinion regarding someone who buys a female slave from them and takes her as an umm walad (a concubine who bears a child)? And what is your opinion on selling them?
Imam (as) said: "If they have a guardian who manages their affairs, sells on their behalf, and looks after their interests, then he will be rewarded for it."
I said: "What do you say about someone who buys a female slave from them and takes her as an umm walad?"
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that if the guardian responsible for their welfare sells to him, considering what is in their best interest. They have no right to revoke what the guardian, acting in their best interest, has done."

t: Chapter on a Man Who Makes a Bequest, but the Executor Forgets it and Only Remembers One Part of it
ar: 5513 - روي محمد بن الحسن الصفار رضي الله عنه عن سهل بن زياد عن محمد بن ريان قال : كتبت اليه يعني علي بن محمد عليه السلام اساله عن انسان اوصي بوصيه فلم يحفظ الوصي الا بابا واحدا منها كيف يصنع في الباقي فوقع عليه السلام "الابواب الباقيه اجعلها في البر".
en:
Hadith.5513 - Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Rayyan, who said:
I wrote to Imam (as) - meaning Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi (as) - asking about a person who had made a will, but the executor only remembered one part of it. What should be done with the remaining parts?
Imam (as) replied: "Allocate the remaining parts to charitable acts."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5088 - روي الحلبي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام انه قال: "لو ان رجلا دخل في الاسلام فاقر به ثم شرب الخمر و زني و اكل الربا و لم يتبين له شيء من الحلال و الحرام لم اقم عليه الحد اذا كان جاهلا الا ان تقوم عليه البينه انه قرا السوره التي فيها الزنا و الخمر و اكل الربا و اذا جهل ذلك اعلمته و اخبرته فان ركبه بعد ذلك جلدته و اقمت عليه الحد".
en:
Hadith.5088 - Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"If a man entered Islam, acknowledged it, and then drank alcohol, committed adultery, and consumed usury, without having any knowledge of what is lawful and unlawful, I would not administer the legal punishment upon him if he was ignorant - unless there was evidence that he had recited the Surah in which adultery, alcohol, and usury are mentioned. If he was unaware of that, I would inform and educate him. But if he committed those acts after that, I would flog him and enforce the legal punishment upon him."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5089 - و في روايه عمرو بن شمر عن جابر يرفعه: ان امير المومنين عليه السلام اتي بالنجاشي الحارثي الشاعر قد شرب الخمر في شهر رمضان فضربه ثمانين ثم حبسه ليله ثم دعا به من الغد فضربه عشرين سوطا فقال يا امير المومنين ضربتني ثمانين سوطا في شرب الخمر فهذه العشرون ما هي فقال "هذا لجراتك علي شرب الخمر في شهر رمضان ".
en:
Hadith.5089 - In the narration of Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who attributed it to the Prophet: Commander of the Faithful (as) was presented with Al-Najashi Al-Harithiyy, the poet, who had consumed alcohol during the month of Ramadan.
Imam (as) flogged him eighty lashes, then imprisoned him for a night.
The next day, Imam (as) summoned him and flogged him with twenty more lashes.
Al-Najashi said: "O' Commander of the Faithful (as), you already flogged me eighty lashes for drinking alcohol. What are these additional twenty for?"
Imam (as) replied: "These are for your audacity in drinking alcohol during the month of Ramadan."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5090 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "لا تجالسوا شراب الخمر فان اللعنه اذا نزلت عمت من في المجلس".
en: Hadith.5090 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said: "Do not sit with those who drink wine, for when the curse descends, it encompasses everyone present in the gathering."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5091 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "شارب الخمر ان مرض فلا تعودوه و ان مات فلا تشهدوه و ان شهد فلا تزكوه و ان خطب اليكم فلا تزوجوه فان من زوج ابنته شارب الخمر فكانما قادها الي الزنا و من زوج ابنته مخالفا له علي دينه فقد قطع رحمها و من ايتمن شارب الخمر لم يكن له علي الله تبارك و تعالي ضمان".
en:
Hadith.5091 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If a wine drinker falls ill, do not visit him; if he dies, do not attend his funeral; if he testifies, do not accept his testimony; and if he seeks marriage from you, do not marry him off.
Whoever marries his daughter to a wine drinker, it is as if he has led her to adultery.
And whoever marries his daughter to someone who opposes his faith has severed her family ties. Whoever entrusts a wine drinker with something has no guarantee from Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5092 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "خمسه من خمسه محال الحرمه من الفاسق محال و الشفقه من العدو محال و النصيحه من الحاسد محال و الوفاء من المراه محال و الهيبه من الفقير محال".
en:
Hadith.5092 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Five things from five are impossible: Honor from a transgressor is impossible, compassion from an enemy is impossible, sincere advice from a jealous person is impossible, loyalty from a woman is impossible, and awe from a poor person is impossible."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5093 - و سيل الصادق عليه السلام : عن قول الله عز و جل ۝ فاجتنبوا الرجس من الاوثان و اجتنبوا قول الزور ۝ قال "الرجس من الاوثان الشطرنج و قول الزور الغناء و النرد اشد من الشطرنج فاما الشطرنج فان اتخاذها كفر و اللعب بها شرك و تعليمها كبيره موبقه و السلام علي اللاهي بها معصيه و مقلبها كمقلب لحم الخنزير و الناظر اليها كالناظر الي فرج امه و اللاعب بالنرد قمارا مثله مثل من ياكل لحم الخنزير و مثل الذي يلعب بها من غير قمار مثل من يضع يده في لحم الخنزير او في دمه و لا يجوز اللعب بالخواتيم و الاربعه عشر و كل ذلك و اشباهه قمار حتي لعب الصبيان بالجوز هو القمار و اياك و الضرب بالصوانيج فان الشيطان يركض معك و الملايكه تنفر عنك و من بقي في بيته طنبور اربعين صباحا "فقد باء بغضب من الله" عز و جل".
en:
Hadith.5093 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
"So avoid the filth of idols and avoid false speech." (Surah Al-Hajj 22:30)
Imam (as) said: "The filth of idols refers to chess, and false speech refers to singing. And backgammon (nard) is worse than chess.
As for chess, adopting it is disbelief, playing it is polytheism, teaching it is a grave and destructive sin, greeting someone engaged in it is disobedience, and touching its pieces is like touching the flesh of swine. Looking at it is like looking at the private parts of one's mother.
The one who plays backgammon with gambling is like one who eats the flesh of swine, and the one who plays it without gambling is like one who places his hand in the flesh or blood of swine.
It is not permissible to play with rings, the fourteen stones, and similar games, as all of them are forms of gambling, even if children play with nuts, it is considered gambling.
Beware of striking the stones together (a form of entertainment), for indeed, Satan runs along with you, and the angels flee from you. And whoever keeps a tambourine in his house for forty days "has incurred the wrath of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5094 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "ان الملايكه لتنفر عند الرهان و تلعن صاحبه ما خلا الحافر و الخف و الريش و النصل و قد سابق رسول الله صلي الله عليه و اله اسامه بن زيد و اجري الخيل ".
en:
Hadith.5094 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, the angels withdraw from gatherings where gambling occurs and curse the one involved in it, except in the case of betting on hoofed animals, animals with padded feet, feathered birds, and arrows. And the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) himself raced with Usamah ibn Zayd and conducted horse races."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5095 - فروي: "ان ناقه النبي صلي الله عليه و اله سبقت فقال عليه السلام "انها بغت و قالت فوقي رسول الله صلي الله عليه و اله و حق علي الله عز و جل ان لا يبغي شيء علي شيء الا اذله الله و لو ان جبلا بغي علي جبل لهد الله الباغي منهما" ".
en:
Hadith.5095 - It has been narrated that the she-camel of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), was outrun in a race. So Prophet (sw), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"It (camel) transgressed and said to itself, 'Upon me is the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family.'
And it is a right upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, that nothing transgresses against anything except that He (swt) humiliates it.
And if a mountain were to transgress against another mountain, Allah would destroy the transgressing one among them."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5096 - : و نهي رسول الله صلي الله عليه و اله عن تحريش البهايم ما خلا الكلاب.
en: Hadith.5096 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) forbade inciting animals against one another, except in the case of dogs.

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Drinking Alcohol and Reports Regarding Singing and Amusements
ar: 5097 - : و سال رجل علي بن الحسين عليهما السلام عن شراء جاريه لها صوت فقال "ما عليك لو اشتريتها فذكرتك الجنه ".
en:
Hadith.5097 - A man asked Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) about purchasing a bondwoman with a beautiful voice.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm upon you if you buy her and she reminds you of Paradise."

t: Chapter on the Executor Purchasing From the deceased's Estate When it is Sold to the Highest Bidder
ar: 5514 - روي محمد بن احمد بن يحيي عن الحسين بن ابراهيم الهمداني قال : كتبت مع محمد بن يحيي هل للوصي ان يشتري شييا من مال الميت اذا بيع فيمن زاد يزيد و ياخذ لنفسه فقال "يجوز اذا اشتري صحيحا".
en:
Hadith.5514 - Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim Al-Hamdani, who said: I wrote along with Muhammad ibn Yahya asking whether the executor of a will is permitted to purchase something from the deceased's estate when it is sold to the highest bidder and take it for himself.
Imam (as) replied: "It is permissible if he purchases it properly."

t: Chapter on a Man Disinheriting His Son for Having Relations with His father's Umm Al-Walad
ar: 5515 - روي الحسن بن علي الوشاء عن محمد بن يحيي عن وصي علي بن السري قال : قلت لابي الحسن عليه السلام ان علي بن السري توفي و اوصي الي فقال "رحمه الله" قلت و ان ابنه جعفرا وقع علي ام ولد له فامرني ان اخرجه من الميراث فقال لي "اخرجه ان كنت صادقا فسيصيبه خبل " قال فرجعت فقدمني الي ابي يوسف القاضي فقال له اصلحك الله انا جعفر بن علي بن السري و هذا وصي ابي فمره ان يدفع الي ميراثي من ابي فقال لي ما تقول فقلت نعم هذا جعفر بن علي بن السري و انا وصي علي بن السري قال فادفع اليه ماله فقلت له اريد ان اكلمك قال فادن مني فدنوت حيث لا يسمع احد كلامي فقلت له هذا وقع علي ام ولد لابيه فامرني ابوه و اوصي الي ان اخرجه من الميراث و لا اورثه شييا فاتيت موسي بن جعفر عليهما السلام بالمدينه فاخبرته و سالته فامرني ان اخرجه من الميراث و لا اورثه شييا فقال الله ان ابا الحسن امرك فقلت نعم فاستحلفني ثلاثا ثم قال لي انفذ ما امرك فالقول قوله قال الوصي فاصابه الخبل بعد ذلك قال ابو محمد الحسن بن علي الوشاء رايته بعد ذلك.
en:
Hadith.5515 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa' narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from the executor of Ali ibn Al-Sari, who said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan (as): "Ali ibn Al-Sari has passed away and appointed me as his executor."
Imam (as) said: "May Allah (swt) have mercy on him."
I said: "His son Ja'far committed an act with his father's umm walad (concubine), and he instructed me to exclude him from the inheritance."
Imam (as) said: "Exclude him if you are truthful, and he will suffer affliction."
He (the executor) said: I returned, and Ja'far brought me before Abu Yusuf the judge. Ja'far said to him, "May Allah (swt) rectify your affairs. I am Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-Sari, and this is my father's executor. Order him to give me my inheritance from my father."
The judge asked me: "What do you say?"
I replied: "Yes, this is Ja'far, the son of Ali ibn Al-Sari, and I am his executor."
The judge said: "Then hand over his wealth to him."
I said: "I wish to speak with you."
He (the judge) said: "Come closer."
I approached him so that no one could hear me, and I said: "This man committed an act with his father's umm walad, and his father commanded me in his will to exclude him from the inheritance and not give him anything. I went to Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), in Medina, informed him, and sought his guidance. Imam (as) ordered me to exclude him from the inheritance and not give him anything."
The judge said: "By Allah (swt), did Abu Al-Hasan command you to do this?"
I said: "Yes."
He (the judge) made me swear three times and then said: "Carry out what you were ordered. His (as) word is decisive."
The executor said: After that, Ja'far was afflicted with madness.
Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa' said: I saw him after that.

t: Chapter on a Man Disinheriting His Son for Having Relations with His father's Umm Al-Walad
ar: 5516 - و تصديق ذلك ما رواه احمد بن محمد بن عيسي عن عبد العزيز بن المهتدي عن سعيد بن سعد قال : سالته يعني ابا الحسن الرضا عليه السلام عن رجل كان له ابن يدعيه فنفاه و اخرجه من الميراث و انا وصيه فكيف اصنع فقال عليه السلام "لزمه الولد لاقراره بالمشهد لا يدفعه الوصي عن شيء قد علمه".
en:
Hadith.5516 - And the confirmation of this is what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abdul Aziz ibn Al-Muhtadi from Sa'id ibn Sa'd, who said:
'I asked Imam (as) - meaning Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) - about a man who had a son whom he acknowledged and then later disowned, excluding him from the inheritance. I am his executor, so what should I do?'
Imam (as) said: "The son remains legally his due to his prior public acknowledgment. The executor cannot deny him anything that is already known."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5517 - روي منصور بن حازم عن هشام عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: "انقطاع يتم اليتيم الاحتلام و هو اشده و ان احتلم و لم يونس منه رشده و كان سفيها او ضعيفا فليمسك عنه وليه ماله".
en:
Hadith.5517 - Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Hisham from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The end of an orphan's state of orphanhood is marked by reaching puberty, and that is when he reaches his full strength. However, if he reaches puberty but no sign of maturity is observed in him, and he is foolish or weak-minded, then his guardian should withhold his wealth from him."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5518 - و روي ابن ابي عمير عن مثني بن راشد عن ابي بصير عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : سالته عن يتيم قد قرا القران و ليس بعقله باس و له مال علي يدي رجل فاراد الذي عنده المال ان يعمل به حتي يحتلم و يدفع اليه ماله قال "و ان احتلم و لم يكن له عقل لم يدفع اليه شيء ابدا".
en:
Hadith.5518 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Mathanna ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: I asked Imam (as) about an orphan who had memorized the Qur'an and had no deficiency in his intellect. The one holding his wealth wishes to invest it until the orphan reaches puberty and then hand over his wealth to him.
Imam (as) said: "Even if he reaches puberty but does not have sound intellect, nothing should ever be handed over to him."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5519 - و روي الحسن بن علي الوشاء عن عبد الله بن سنان عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : "اذا بلغ الغلام اشده ثلاث عشره سنه و دخل في الاربع عشره سنه وجب عليه ما وجب علي المحتلمين احتلم او لم يحتلم و كتبت عليه السييات و كتبت له الحسنات و جاز له كل شيء الا ان يكون ضعيفا او سفيها".
en: Hadith.5519 - Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa' narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "When a boy reaches the age of thirteen and enters into his fourteenth year, what is obligatory upon those who have reached puberty becomes obligatory upon him, whether he experiences a wet dream or not. His bad deeds are recorded against him, and his good deeds are recorded for him. Everything becomes permissible for him except if he is weak-minded or foolish."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5520 - و روي صفوان بن يحيي عن عيص بن القاسم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : سالته عن اليتيمه متي يدفع اليها مالها قال "اذا علمت انها لا تفسد و لا تضيع" فسالته ان كانت قد تزوجت فقال "اذا تزوجت فقد انقطع ملك الوصي عنها".
en:
Hadith.5520 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from 'Is ibn Al-Qasim from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: I asked Imam (as) about an orphan girl - when should her wealth be handed over to her?
Imam (as) said: "When you know that she will neither corrupt it nor waste it."
I then asked Imam (as): "What if she has gotten married?"
Imam (as) said: "Once she marries, the authority of the guardian over her ends."
COMPEV
قَالَ مُصَنِّفُ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ إِذَا بَلَغَتْ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ.
The author of this book, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, commented: This means when she reaches the age of nine years.

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5521 - و روي موسي بن بكر عن زراره عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال : "لا يدخل بالجاريه حتي ياتي لها تسع سنين او عشر".
en: Hadith.5521 - Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said: "A girl should not be consummated in marriage until she reaches nine or ten years of age."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5522 - و قال ابو عبد الله عليه السلام : "اذا بلغت الجاريه تسع سنين دفع اليها مالها و جاز امرها في مالها و اقيمت الحدود التامه لها و عليها".
en: Hadith.5522 - Abu Abdullah (as), said: "When a girl reaches nine years of age, her wealth is handed over to her, her decisions regarding her wealth become valid, and the full legal punishments are applied for her and upon her."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5523 - و قد روي عن الصادق عليه السلام : انه سيل عن قول الله عز و جل ۝ فان انستم منهم رشدا فادفعوا اليهم اموالهم ۝ قال "ايناس الرشد حفظ المال".
en:
Hadith.5523 - It was narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), that he was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious:
"But if you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam (as) said: "Perceiving sound judgment means the ability to safeguard wealth."

t: Chapter on the Cessation of an orphan's Orphanhood
ar: 5524 - و في روايه محمد بن احمد بن يحيي عن محمد بن الحسين عن عبد الله بن المغيره عمن ذكر عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : انه قال في تفسير هذه الايه ۝ اذا رايتموهم يحبون ال محمد عليهم السلام فارفعوهم درجه ۝.
en:
Hadith.5524 - In the narration of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from someone who mentioned from Abu Abdullah (as), that Imam (as) said in the interpretation of this verse:
"If you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam (as) said: "If you see that they love the family of Muhammad (sw), peace be upon them, then elevate them in status."

t: Chapter on Those Who Are Not Prevented From Inheriting
ar: 5620 - روي محمد بن سنان عن العلاء بن فضيل عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : "ان الوليد و الطفل لا يحجبك و لا يرثك الا من اذن بالصراخ و لا شيء اكنه البطن و ان تحرك الا ما اختلف عليه الليل و النهار".
en:
Hadith.5620 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, a newborn or an infant does not prevent you (from inheritance) nor inherits from you unless they have cried aloud. Anything concealed in the womb, even if it moves, has no share in inheritance except what the passage of night and day might change."

t: Chapter on What Has Been Reported Regarding One Who Refuses to Take His Wealth After Reaching Maturity
ar: 5525 - روي احمد بن محمد بن عيسي عن سعد بن اسماعيل عن ابيه قال : سالت الرضا عليه السلام عن وصي ايتام يدرك ايتامه فيعرض عليهم ان ياخذوا الذي لهم فيابون عليه كيف يصنع قال "يرد عليهم و يكرههم عليه".
en:
Hadith.5525 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Sa'd ibn Isma'il from his father, who said: I asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) about the guardian of orphans whose wards have reached maturity. He offers them their rightful wealth, but they refuse to take it. What should he do?
Imam (as) said: "He must return their wealth to them and compel them to take it."

t: Chapter on the Executor Withholding the heir's Wealth After Maturity, Leading Him to Commit Adultery Due to His Inability to Marry
ar: 5526 - روي محمد بن يعقوب الكليني رضي الله عنه عن محمد بن يحيي عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد بن قيس عمن رواه عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : في رجل مات و اوصي الي رجل و له ابن صغير فادرك الغلام و ذهب الي الوصي فقال له رد علي مالي لاتزوج فابي عليه فذهب حتي زني قال "يلزم ثلثي اثم زني هذا الرجل ذلك الوصي الذي منعه المال و لم يعطه فكان يتزوج".
en:
Hadith.5526 - Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Qays from someone who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said regarding a man who died and appointed someone as the guardian of his affairs while leaving behind a young son.
When the boy grew up, he went to the guardian and said: "Return my wealth to me so I can get married," but the guardian refused. The boy then went and committed adultery.
Abu Abdullah (as), said: "Two-thirds of the sin of this man's adultery is upon the guardian who withheld his wealth and did not give it to him, which would have allowed him to marry."

t: Chapter on What Has Been Reported Regarding One Who Makes a Bequest or Frees a Slave While in Debt
ar: 5527 - روي محمد بن ابي عمير عن جميل بن دراج عن زكريا بن ابي يحيي السعدي عن الحكم بن عتيبه قال : كنا علي باب ابي جعفر ع و نحن جماعه ننتظر ان يخرج اذ جاءت امراه فقالت ايكم ابو جعفر فقال لها القوم ما تريدين منه قالت اساله عن مساله فقالوا لها هذا فقيه اهل العراق فاساليه فقالت ان زوجي مات و ترك الف درهم و كان لي عليه دين من صداقي خمسمايه درهم فاخذت صداقي و اخذت ميراثي ثم جاء رجل فادعي عليه الف درهم فشهدت له قال الحكم فبينا انا احسب اذ خرج ابو جعفر عليه السلام فقال "ما هذا الذي اراك تحرك به اصابعك يا حكم " فقلت ان هذه المراه ذكرت ان زوجها مات و ترك الف درهم و كان لها عليه من صداقها خمسمايه درهم فاخذت منه صداقها و اخذت منه ميراثها ثم جاء رجل فادعي عليه الف درهم فشهدت له قال الحكم فو الله ما اتممت الكلام حتي قال "اقرت بثلثي ما في يديها و لا ميراث لها" قال الحكم فما رايت و الله افهم من ابي جعفر عليه السلام قط. قال ابن ابي عمير و تفسير ذلك انه لا ميراث حتي يقضي الدين و انما ترك الف درهم و عليه من الدين الف و خمسمايه درهم لها و للرجل فلها ثلث الالف لان لها خمسمايه درهم و للرجل الف درهم فله ثلثاها.
en:
Hadith.5527 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zakariya ibn Abi Yahya Al-Sa'di from Al-Hakam ibn Utaibah, who said:
We were sitting at the door of Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), as a group waiting for him to come out. Suddenly, a woman approached and asked: "Which of you is Abu Ja'far?"
The people replied: "What do you need from him?" She said: "I want to ask him a question."
They told her: "This is the jurist of the people of Iraq, so ask him."
She said: "My husband passed away and left behind one thousand dirhams. I had a debt upon him from my dowry of five hundred dirhams. I took my dowry and also took my share of the inheritance. Then a man came and claimed that the deceased owed him one thousand dirhams, and I testified in his favor."
Al-Hakam said: While I was pondering this, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), came out and said: "What is this that I see you counting with your fingers, O' Hakam?"
I said: "This woman mentioned that her husband died, leaving one thousand dirhams. She had five hundred dirhams as her dowry, which she took, and she also took her share of the inheritance. Then a man came claiming that the deceased owed him one thousand dirhams, and she testified in his favor."
Al-Hakam said: By Allah (swt), I had not even finished speaking when Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), said:
"She has admitted to two-thirds of what she possesses, and she has no right to any inheritance."
Al-Hakam said: By Allah (swt), I have never seen anyone more insightful than Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as).
Ibn Abi Umayr said: The explanation of this is that there is no inheritance until debts are settled.
The deceased only left one thousand dirhams, while he owed a total debt of one thousand five hundred dirhams - five hundred dirhams to her (as her dowry) and one thousand dirhams to the man. Therefore, she is entitled to one-third of the remaining amount because of her five hundred dirham debt, and the man is entitled to two-thirds due to his claim of one thousand dirhams.

t: Chapter on What Has Been Reported Regarding One Who Makes a Bequest or Frees a Slave While in Debt
ar: 5528 - و روي ابن ابي عمير عن جميل بن دراج عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في رجل اعتق مملوكه عند موته و عليه دين فقال "ان كان قيمته مثل الذي عليه و مثله جاز عتقه و الا لم يجز".
en:
Hadith.5528 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who freed his slave at the time of his death while he had a debt upon him.
Imam (as) said: "If the value of the slave is equal to the amount of debt he owes or more, then his emancipation is valid; otherwise, it is not valid."

t: Chapter on What Has Been Reported Regarding One Who Makes a Bequest or Frees a Slave While in Debt
ar: 5529 - و في روايه ابان بن عثمان قال : سال رجل ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل اوصي الي رجل ان عليه دينا فقال "يقضي الرجل ما عليه من دينه و يقسم ما بقي بين الورثه" قلت فيفرق الوصي ما كان اوصي به في الدين ممن يوخذ الدين ا من الورثه ام من الوصي فقال "لا يوخذ من الورثه و لكن الوصي ضامن له".
en:
Hadith.5529 - In the narration of Aban ibn Uthman, it is reported that a man asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who had made a will appointing someone as his executor, stating that he had a debt upon him.
Abu Abdullah (as), said: "The executor should settle the debt owed by the deceased and then distribute whatever remains among the heirs."
The man then asked: "Should the executor distribute what was bequeathed for the debt? Should the debt be collected from the heirs or from the executor?"
Imam (as) replied: "It is not to be taken from the heirs; rather, the executor is responsible for it."

t: Chapter on the Clearance of the deceased's Liability From Debt When Someone Guarantees it for the Creditors with Their Consent
ar: 5530 - روي الحسن بن محبوب عن عبد الله بن سنان عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في الرجل يموت و عليه دين فيضمنه ضامن للغرماء قال "اذا رضي الغرماء فقد بريت ذمه الميت".
en:
Hadith.5530 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who dies while owing a debt, and a guarantor assumes responsibility for it on behalf of the creditors.
Imam (as) said: "If the creditors agree, then the deceased is cleared of responsibility."

t: Chapter on a Sold Item That Remains Intact When the Buyer Dies While in Debt and Owing Its Price
ar: 5531 - روي محمد بن ابي عمير عن جميل بن دراج عن بعض اصحابنا عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في رجل باع متاعا من رجل فقبض المشتري المتاع و لم يدفع الثمن ثم مات المشتري و المتاع قايم بعينه فقال "اذا كان المتاع قايما بعينه رد الي صاحب المتاع و ليس للغرماء ان يخاصموه".
en:
Hadith.5531 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj from one of our companions from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who sold merchandise to another man. The buyer took possession of the merchandise but did not pay the price, and then the buyer died while the merchandise was still in its original form.
Imam (as) said: "If the merchandise remains in its original state, it should be returned to the seller, and the creditors have no right to dispute over it."

t: Chapter on Settling Debt From Blood Money (diyyah)
ar: 5532 - روي صفوان بن يحيي الازرق عن ابي الحسن عليه السلام : في الرجل يقتل و عليه دين و لم يترك مالا فاخذ اهله الديه من قاتله عليهم ان يقضوا دينه قال "نعم" قلت و هو لم يترك شييا قال "انما اخذوا ديته فعليهم ان يقضوا دينه".
en:
Hadith.5532 - Safwan ibn Yahya Al-Azraq narrated from Abu Al-Hasan (as), regarding a man who was killed while owing a debt and left behind no wealth. His family took the blood money (diyyah) from his killer. Should they use it to settle his debt?
Imam (as) said: "Yes."
I asked: "Even though he left nothing behind?"
Imam (as) replied: "They took his blood money, so they must use it to settle his debt."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5098 - روي عن ابي الحسن الرضا عليه السلام انه قال: "لا يزال العبد يسرق حتي اذا استوفي ديه يده اظهره الله عز و جل عليه".
en:
Hadith.5098 - It is narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as)  that he said:
"A servant continues to steal until, when the value of what he has stolen equals the blood money for his hand, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, exposes him."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5099 - و في روايه السكوني عن جعفر بن محمد عن ابيه عليه السلام قال: "لا يقطع السارق في عام سنه مجدبه".
en:
Hadith.5099 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that he said:
"The hand of a thief is not to be cut off during a year of drought."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5100 - و في روايه غياث بن ابراهيم عن ابي عبد الله عن ابيه عليهما السلام : "ان عليا عليه السلام اتي بالكوفه برجل سرق حماما فلم يقطعه و قال "لا اقطع في الطير" ".
en: Hadith.5100 - In the narration of Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), it is reported: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was presented in Kufa with a man who had stolen a pigeon, but he did not cut off his hand and said: 'I do not cut off (a hand) for stealing birds.'"

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5101 - و روي سعد بن طريف عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: "قطع علي عليه السلام في بيضه حديد و في جنه وزنها ثمانيه و ثلاثون رطلا".
en: Hadith.5101 - Sa'd ibn Tarif narrated from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ordered the cutting off of a hand for stealing an iron helmet and for a shield that weighed thirty-eight ratl (a unit of weight)."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5102 - و روي حماد عن الحلبي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في رجل اتي رجلا فقال ارسلني فلان اليك لترسل اليه بكذا و كذا فاعطاه و صدقه فلقي صاحبه فقال له ان رسولك اتاني فبعثت اليك معه بكذا و كذا فقال ما ارسلته اليك و لا اتاني احد بشيء فزعم الرسول انه قد ارسله و قد دفعه اليه قال "ان وجد عليه بينه انه لم يرسله قطعت يده و ان لم يجد عليه بينه فيمينه بالله ما ارسله و يستوفي الاخر من الرسول المال" قلت فان زعم انه حمله علي ذلك الحاجه قال "يقطع لانه سرق مال الرجل".
en:
Hadith.5102 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who went to another man and said: "So-and-so sent me to you to collect such-and-such," and the man gave it to him, believing him.
Later, he met the original person and said: "Your messenger came to me, and I sent with him such-and-such," but the man replied:
"I did not send him to you, nor did anyone bring me anything."
The supposed messenger then claimed that he had indeed been sent and had delivered the item to him.
Imam (as) said: "If proof is established against him that he was never sent, his hand is to be cut off. But if there is no proof, the man must swear by Allah (swt) that he did not send him, and the other must recover his money from the messenger."
I asked: "What if he claims that necessity compelled him to do so?"
Imam (as) replied: "His hand is to be cut off because he has stolen the man's wealth."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5103 - و روي عن احدهما عليهما السلام انه قال: "لا يقطع السارق حتي يقر بالسرقه مرتين فان رجع ضمن السرقه و لم يقطع اذا لم يكن له شهود".
en:
Hadith.5103 - It is narrated from one of the two Imams (as) that Imam (as) said:
"The hand of a thief is not to be cut off until he confesses to the theft twice. If he retracts his confession, he must compensate for what he stole, but his hand will not be cut off if there are no witnesses against him."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5104 - و في روايه السكوني قال قال علي عليه السلام : "كل مدخل يدخل اليه بغير اذن فسرق منه السارق فلا قطع عليه".
en: Hadith.5104 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Every place that can be entered without permission, and a thief steals from it, there is no cutting off of the hand."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5105 - و روي العلاء عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: سالته عن الصبي يسرق قال "ان كان له سبع سنين او اقل رفع عنه فان عاد بعد السبع قطعت بنانه او حكت حتي تدمي فان عاد قطع منه اسفل من بنانه فان عاد بعد ذلك و قد بلغ تسع سنين قطعت يده و لا يضيع حد من حدود الله عز و جل".
en:
Hadith.5105 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: I asked Imam (as) about a child who steals.
Imam (as) said: "If he is seven years old or younger, the punishment is lifted from him.
But if he repeats the act after the age of seven, his fingertip is to be cut off or scraped until it bleeds.
If he repeats it again, a part below his fingertip is to be cut off.
If he steals again after that and has reached nine years of age, his hand is to be cut off.
None of the prescribed punishments of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, are to be neglected."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5106 - : و جاء رجل الي امير المومنين عليه السلام فاقر بالسرقه فقال له امير المومنين عليه السلام "ا تقرا شييا من كتاب الله عز و جل" قال نعم سوره البقره فقال "قد وهبت يدك لسوره البقره " فقال الاشعث ا تعطل حدا من حدود الله تعالي فقال "و ما يدريك ما هذا اذا قامت البينه فليس للامام ان يعفو و اذا اقر الرجل علي نفسه فذاك الي الامام ان شاء عفا و ان شاء قطع".
en:
Hadith.5106 - A man came to Commander of the Faithful (as) and confessed to theft.
Commander of the Faithful (as) asked him: "Do you recite anything from the Book of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic?"
The man replied: "Yes, Surah Al-Baqarah."
Imam (as) said: "I have pardoned your hand for the sake of Surah Al-Baqarah."
Al-Ashath objected, saying: "Are you suspending one of the punishments prescribed by Allah (swt), the Exalted?"
Commander of the Faithful (as) replied: "And what do you know about this matter? When evidence is established, the Imam has no authority to pardon, but when a man confesses against himself, then it is up to the Imam - if he wishes, he may pardon, and if he wishes, he may order the cutting."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5107 - و في روايه السكوني قال قال رسول الله صلي الله عليه و اله : "لا قطع في ثمر و لا كثر و الكثر هو الجمار".
en:
Hadith.5107 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "There is no cutting (of the hand) for stealing fruit or kathar."
And kathar refers to the inner core of palm trees (Al-jummar).

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5108 - و روي محمد بن قيس عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: "قضي امير المومنين عليه السلام في نفر نحروا بعيرا فاكلوه فامتحنوا ايهم نحر فشهدوا علي انفسهم انهم نحروه جميعا لم يخصوا احدا دون احد فقضي ان تقطع ايمانهم".
en: Hadith.5108 - Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled in the case of a group of people who slaughtered a camel and ate it. They were investigated to determine who among them had slaughtered it, and they all testified against themselves that they had collectively slaughtered it without specifying any individual over another. So, Imam (as) ruled that their right hands be cut off."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5109 - و روي يونس عن عبد الله بن سنان عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: قلت له رجل سرق من المغنم الشيء الذي يجب عليه القطع قال "ينظر كم الذي يصيبه فان كان الذي اخذ اقل من نصيبه عزر و دفع اليه تمام ماله و ان كان اخذ مثل الذي له فلا شيء عليه و ان كان اخذ فضلا بقدر ثمن مجن و هو ربع دينار قطع".
en:
Hadith.5109 - Yunus narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who stole from the war spoils an amount that would normally require his hand to be cut off.
Imam (as) said: "It should be examined how much his rightful share is. If what he took was less than his portion, he is to be disciplined (ta'zir) and given the remainder of his share.
If he took exactly what was due to him, then there is nothing upon him.
But if he took more than his share equal to the value of a shield, which is a quarter of a dinar, then his hand is to be cut off."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5110 - و روي موسي بن بكر عن زراره عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: سالته عن رجل اكتري حمارا و اقبل الي اصحاب الثياب فابتاع منهم ثوبا و ترك الحمار عندهم قال "يرد الحمار علي اصحابه و يتبع الذي ذهب بالثوب و ليس عليه قطع انما هي خيانه".
en:
Hadith.5110 - Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who rented a donkey and went to cloth merchants, bought a garment from them, and left the donkey with them.
Imam (as) said: "The donkey should be returned to its owner, and the one who took the garment should be pursued. However, there is no cutting (of the hand) upon him because this is an act of betrayal, not theft."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5111 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "كان امير المومنين عليه السلام اذا سرق الرجل اولا قطع يمينه فان عاد قطع رجله اليسري فان عاد ثالثه خلده السجن و انفق عليه من بيت المال".
en:
Hadith.5111 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When a man committed theft for the first time, Commander of the Faithful (as) would cut off his right hand. If he repeated the theft, he would cut off his left foot. If he stole a third time, he would imprison him for life and provide for him from the public treasury."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5112 - و روي: "انه ان سرق في السجن قتل ".
en: Hadith.5112 - It has been narrated: "If he steals while in prison, he is to be executed."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5113 - و سيل ابو عبد الله عليه السلام : عن ادني ما يقطع فيه السارق قال "ربع دينار".
en:
Hadith.5113 - Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about the minimum amount for which a thief's hand is to be cut off.
Imam (as) said: "A quarter of a dinar."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5114 - و في خبر اخر: "خمس دينار".
en: Hadith.5114 - In another narration, it is reported: "One-fifth of a dinar."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5115 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن علي بن رياب عن زراره عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام : في رجل سرق فقطعت يده اليمني ثم سرق فقطعت رجله اليسري ثم سرق الثالثه قال "كان امير المومنين عليه السلام يخلده في السجن و يقول "اني لاستحيي من ربي ان ادعه بلا يد يستنظف بها و لا رجل يمشي بها الي حاجته" " قال "و كان اذا قطع اليد قطعها دون المفصل و اذا قطع الرجل قطعها من الكعب " قال "و كان لا يري ان يعفي, عن شيء من الحدود".
en:
Hadith.5115 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who stole, and his right hand was cut off. Then he stole again, and his left foot was cut off. Then he stole a third time.
Imam (as) said: "Commander of the Faithful (as) would imprison him for life and would say, 'I feel ashamed before my Lord (azj) to leave him without a hand to clean himself with and without a foot to walk with to fulfill his needs.'"
Imam Al-Baqir (as) added: "When Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) would cut off the hand, he would cut it below the wrist joint, and when he would cut off the foot, he would cut it from the ankle."
Imam Al-Baqir (as) also stated: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) did not believe that any of the prescribed punishments should be pardoned."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5116 - و روي الحسن بن محبوب عن علي بن الحسن بن رباط عن ابن مسكان عن الحلبي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: "اذا اقيم علي السارق الحد نفي الي بلده اخري و ان سرق رجل فلم يقدر عليه حتي سرق مره اخري فاخذ فجاءت البينه فشهدوا عليه بالسرقه الاولي و الاخيره فانه تقطع يده بالسرقه الاولي و لا تقطع رجله بالسرقه الاخيره لان الشهود شهدوا عليه جميعا في مقام واحد بالسرقه الاولي و الاخيره قبل ان تقطع يده بالسرقه الاولي و لو ان الشهود شهدوا عليه بالسرقه الاولي فقطعت يده ثم شهدوا عليه بعد بالسرقه الاخيره قطعت رجله اليسري".
en:
Hadith.5116 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribat from Ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"When the legal punishment is carried out on a thief, he is to be exiled to another town. If a man steals and is not caught until he steals again and is then apprehended, and evidence is brought against him, with witnesses testifying to both the first and the most recent theft, his hand is to be cut off for the first theft, but his foot is not to be cut off for the second theft.
This is because the witnesses testified to both thefts at the same time before his hand was cut off for the first theft.
However, if the witnesses had testified regarding the first theft and his hand was cut off, and then later testified about the second theft, his left foot would be cut off."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5117 - و قال علي عليه السلام : "لا قطع في الدغاره المعلنه و هي الخلسه و لكني اعزره و لكن يقطع من ياخذ و يخفي". و ليس علي الذي يسلب الثياب قطع و ليس علي الطرار قطع اذا طر من القميص الاعلي فان طر من القميص الاسفل فعليه القطع و ليس علي الاجير و لا علي الضيف قطع لانهما موتمنان و قد روي انه ان اضاف الضيف ضيفا فسرق قطع و الاشل اذا سرق قطعت يمينه علي كل حال شلاء كانت او صحيحه فان عاد فسرق قطعت رجله اليسري فان عاد خلد السجن و اجري عليه من بيت مال المسلمين و كف عن الناس روي ذلك الحسن بن محبوب عن علاء عن محمد بن مسلم عن زراره عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام. و رواه الحسن بن محبوب عن عبد الله بن سنان عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام و ليس علي العبد اذا سرق من مال مولاه قطع لانه مال الرجل سرق بعضه بعضا".
en:
Hadith.5117 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"There is no cutting (of the hand) for open and public theft, which is snatching (Al-khulsah), but I would discipline him (ta'zir).
However, the one who steals and conceals what he takes is to have his hand cut off."
There is no cutting (of the hand) for one who snatches clothing, nor is there cutting for a pickpocket (ṭarrar) if he steals from the outer garment.
However, if he steals from the inner garment, then cutting is applied.
There is also no cutting for a worker (ajir) or a guest (ḍayf) because they are entrusted.
However, it has been narrated that if a guest hosts another guest who then steals, his hand is to be cut.
If a paralyzed person (ashall) steals, his right hand is to be cut off regardless of whether it is paralyzed or healthy. If he steals again, his left foot is to be cut off. If he steals a third time, he is to be imprisoned for life, provided for from the public treasury of the Muslims, and restrained from harming people.
This was narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Al-Alaa from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Zurarah from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), and also by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as).
Additionally, there is no cutting for a slave if he steals from the property of his master because it is considered the wealth of the man himself, as if a part of him has stolen from another part.

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5118 - : "و النباش اذا كان معروفا بذلك قطع".
en: Hadith.5118 - "The grave robber (Al-nabbash), if he is known for doing that, is to have his hand cut off."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5119 - و روي: "ان عليا عليه السلام قطع نباش القبر فقيل له ا تقطع في الموتي فقال "انا لنقطع لامواتنا كما نقطع لاحياينا" ".
en:
Hadith.5119 - It has been narrated that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ordered the hand of a grave robber to be cut off.
Imam (as) was asked: "Do you cut off (the hand) for stealing from the dead?"
Imam (as) replied: "We cut for our dead just as we cut for our living."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5120 - و روي: "ان امير المومنين عليه السلام اتي بنباش فاخذ بشعره و جلد به الارض ثم قال "طيوا عليه عباد الله" فوطي حتي مات".
en:
Hadith.5120 - It has been narrated that Commander of the Faithful (as) was presented with a grave robber.
Imam (as) grabbed him by his hair, struck him against the ground, and then said: "Step on him, O' servants of Allah (swt)." So, the people trampled him until he died.

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5121 - و سيل الصادق عليه السلام : عن قول الله عز و جل ۝ انما جزاء الذين يحاربون الله و رسوله و يسعون في الارض فسادا ان يقتلوا او يصلبوا او تقطع ايديهم و ارجلهم من خلاف او ينفوا من الارض ۝ فقال "اذا قتل و لم يحارب و لم ياخذ المال قتل و اذا حارب و قتل قتل و صلب و اذا حارب و اخذ المال و لم يقتل قطعت يده و رجله و اذا حارب و لم يقتل و لم ياخذ المال نفي".
en:
Hadith.5121 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
"The punishment of those who wage war against Allah (swt) and His Messenger and strive to spread corruption on earth is that they be killed, or crucified, or have their hands and feet cut off from opposite sides, or be exiled from the land" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:33).
Imam (as) said: "If a person kills but does not engage in combat and does not take wealth, he is to be executed.
If he engages in combat and kills, he is to be killed and crucified.
If he engages in combat and takes wealth but does not kill, his hand and foot are to be cut off.
And if he engages in combat but does not kill and does not take wealth, he is to be exiled."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5122 - و قال الصادق عليه السلام : "المصلوب ينزل عن الخشبه بعد ثلاثه ايام يغسل و يدفن و لا يجوز صلبه اكثر من ثلاثه ايام".
en:
Hadith.5122 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The crucified person is to be taken down from the wooden structure after three days, washed, and buried. It is not permissible to keep him crucified for more than three days."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5123 - و في روايه السكوني عن جعفر بن محمد عن ابيه عليه السلام : "ان عليا عليه السلام صلب رجلا, بالحيره ثلاثه ايام ثم انزله يوم الرابع فصلي عليه و دفنه".
en:
Hadith.5123 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), it is reported:
"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) crucified a man in Al-Hirah for three days. Then on the fourth day, Imam (as) took him down, prayed over him, and buried him."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5124 - و روي علي بن رياب عن ضريس عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: "من حمل السلاح بالليل فهو محارب الا ان يكون رجلا ليس من اهل الريبه".
en: Hadith.5124 - Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Ḍurays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "Whoever carries a weapon at night is considered a highway robber (muharib), unless he is a man who is not known for suspicion or wrongdoing."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5125 - و روي صفوان بن يحيي عن طلحه النهدي عن سوره بن كليب قال: قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام رجل يخرج من منزله يريد المسجد او يريد الحاجه فيلقاه رجل او يستقبله فيضربه و ياخذ ثوبه قال "اي شيء يقول فيه من قبلكم" قال قلت يقولون هذه دغاره معلنه و انما المحارب في قري مشركيه فقال "ايهما اعظم حرمه دار الاسلام او دار الشرك" قال فقلت دار الاسلام قال "هولاء من اهل هذه الايه: ۝ انما جزاء الذين يحاربون الله و رسوله ۝ " الي اخر الايه.
en:
Hadith.5125 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Talhah Al-Nahdi from Sawrah ibn Kulayb who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who leaves his house intending to go to the mosque or fulfill a need and is met or confronted by another man who strikes him and takes his garment.
Abu Abdullah (as) asked: "What do the people in your region say about this?"
I replied: "They say this is open aggression (dagharah muʿlanah), and that a highway robber (muharib) only exists in the lands of polytheists."
Imam (as) then asked: "Which is more sacred: the land of Islam or the land of polytheism?"
I replied: "The land of Islam."
Imam (as) said: "These people fall under the ruling of this verse:
'The punishment of those who wage war against Allah (swt) and His Messenger'" (until the end of the verse). (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:33)

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5126 - و روي عن طريف بن سنان الثوري قال: سالت جعفر بن محمد عليه السلام عن رجل سرق حره فباعها فقال "فيها اربعه حدود اما اولها فسارق تقطع يده و الثانيه ان كان وطيها جلد الحد و علي الذي اشتري ان كان وطيها و قد علم ان كان محصنا رجم و ان كان غير محصن جلد الحد و ان كان لم يعلم فلا شيء عليه و لا عليها هي و ان كان استكرهها فلا شيء عليها و ان كانت طاوعته جلدت الحد".
en:
Hadith.5126 - It was narrated from Tarif ibn Sinan Al-Thawri who said:
I asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who stole a free woman and sold her.
Imam (as) said: "There are four legal punishments in this case.
The first is that since he stole, his hand is to be cut off.
The second is that if he had intercourse with her, he is to be flogged with the legal punishment.
The third is upon the one who bought her: if he had intercourse with her and knew her status, then if he was married (muhsan), he is to be stoned, and if he was unmarried (non-muhsan), he is to be flogged with the legal punishment. However, if he did not know (her status), then there is nothing upon him or upon her.
The fourth is that if she was forced into it, there is no punishment upon her, but if she consented, she is to be flogged with the legal punishment."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5127 - و روي محمد بن عبد الله بن هلال عن ابيه عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: قلت له اخبرني عن السارق لم تقطع يده اليمني و رجله اليسري و لا تقطع يده اليمني و رجله اليمني فقال "ما احسن ما سالت اذا قطعت يده اليمني و رجله اليمني سقط علي جانبه الايسر و لم يقدر علي القيام و اذا قطعت يده اليمني و رجله اليسري اعتدل و استوي قايما" قال قلت جعلت فداك كيف يقوم و قد قطعت رجله قال "ان القطع ليس من حيث رايت تقطع انما تقطع الرجل من الكعب و يترك له من قدمه ما يقوم عليه يصلي و يعبد الله عز و جل" قلت فمن اين تقطع اليد قال "تقطع الاربع الاصابع و يترك له الابهام يعتمد عليها في الصلاه يغسل بها وجهه للصلاه".
en:
Hadith.5127 - Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal narrated from his father from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as): "Tell me why the right hand and the left foot of a thief are cut off, but not the right hand and the right foot?"
Imam (as) replied: "What a good question you have asked! If his right hand and right foot were cut off, he would fall onto his left side and would not be able to stand. But when his right hand and left foot are cut off, he remains balanced and can stand upright."
I said: "May I be your ransom, how can he stand when his foot has been cut off?"
Imam (as) replied: "The cutting is not as you perceive it. The foot is cut off from the ankle, leaving part of the foot so that he can stand on it, perform prayer, and worship Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
I asked: "From where is the hand cut off?"
Imam (as) replied: "The four fingers are cut off, and the thumb is left for him so that he may lean on it during prayer and wash his face for prayer."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5128 - و روي اسحاق بن عمار عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : في رجل سرق من بستان عذقا قيمته درهمان قال "يقطع به".
en:
Hadith.5128 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who stole a cluster of dates from an orchard worth two dirhams.
Imam (as) said: "His hand is to be cut off for that."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5129 - و روي علي بن رياب عن ضريس الكناسي عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: "العبد اذا اقر علي نفسه عند الامام مره انه سرق قطعه و الامه اذا اقرت علي نفسها عند الامام بالسرقه قطعها".
en:
Hadith.5129 - Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Ḍurays Al-Kunasi from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"If a male slave confesses to theft once before the Imam, his hand is to be cut off.
Likewise, if a female slave confesses to theft before the Imam, her hand is to be cut off."

t: Chapter on the Legal Punishment for Theft
ar: 5130 - روي ذلك الحسن بن محبوب عن ابي ايوب عن الفضيل بن يسار قال سمعت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام يقول: "اذا اقر المملوك علي نفسه بالسرقه لم يقطع و ان شهد عليه شاهدان قطع".
en: Hadith.5130 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "If a slave confesses to theft, his hand is not to be cut off. However, if two witnesses testify against him, his hand is to be cut off."

t: Chapter on the Disapproval of Appointing a Woman as an Executor of a Bequest
ar: 5533 - روي السكوني عن جعفر بن محمد عن ابيه عن ابايه عليهم السلام قال قال امير المومنين عليه السلام : "المراه لا يوصي اليها لان الله عز و جل يقول ۝ و لا توتوا السفهاء اموالكم ۝.
en:
Hadith.5533 - Al-Sakuni narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said that the Commander of the Faithful (as) said:
"A woman should not be appointed as an executor of a will because Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, says: "And do not give the weak-minded your wealth" (Surah An-Nisa 4:5)."

t: Chapter on the Disapproval of Appointing a Woman as an Executor of a Bequest
ar: 5534 - و في خبر اخر : سيل ابو جعفر عليه السلام عن قول الله عز و جل "و لا توتوا السفهاء اموالكم" قال "لا توتوها شارب الخمر و لا النساء" ثم قال "و اي سفيه اسفه من شارب الخمر".
en:
Hadith.5534 - In another narration, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious:
"And do not give the weak-minded your wealth." (Qur'an 4:5).
Imam (as) said: "Do not give it to one who drinks alcohol or to women."
Then Imam (as) added: "And who is more foolish than a person who drinks alcohol?"

t: Chapter on the Obligation of the Executor of the Executor in Fulfilling the Bequest
ar: 5535 - كتب محمد بن الحسن الصفار رضي الله عنه الي ابي محمد الحسن بن علي عليه السلام : رجل كان وصي رجل فمات و اوصي الي رجل اخر هل يلزم الوصي وصيه الرجل الذي كان هذا وصيه فكتب عليه السلام "يلزمه بحقه ان كان له قبله حق ان شاء الله".
en:
Hadith.5535 - Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, wrote to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as), asking:
"A man was the executor of another man's will, and then he died and appointed another man as his executor. Is the second executor obligated to fulfill the will of the man for whom the first executor was appointed?"
Imam (as) wrote in response: "He is obligated by his right if there is a rightful claim upon him, if Allah (swt) wills."

t: Chapter on a Man Who Bequeaths a Portion of His Wealth to Another and is Then Killed by Mistake
ar: 5536 - روي عاصم بن حميد عن محمد بن قيس قال : قلت له رجل اوصي لرجل بوصيه من ماله ثلث او ربع فيقتل الرجل خطا يعني الموصي فقال "تجاز لهذا الوصيه من ماله و من ديته ".
en:
Hadith.5536 - Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who bequeathed a portion of his wealth - a third or a fourth - to another man. Then, the man (the testator) was mistakenly killed.
Imam (as) said: "The will is to be executed from his wealth and from his blood money (diyyah)."

t: Chapter on a Man Who Bequeaths a Portion of His Wealth to Another and is Then Killed by Mistake
ar: 5537 - و في خبر اخر : سيل ابو عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل اوصي بثلث ماله ثم قتل خطا قال "ثلث ديته داخل في وصيته".
en:
Hadith.5537 - In another narration, Abu Abdullah (as), was asked about a man who had bequeathed one-third of his wealth and was then killed by mistake.
Imam (as) said: "One-third of his blood money (diyyah) is included in his bequest."

t: Chapter on a Man Who Appoints Another as the Guardian of His Children and Their Wealth, Permitting Him at the Time of the Bequest to Invest the Wealth, with the Profits Shared Between Him and Them
ar: 5538 - روي محمد بن يعقوب الكليني رضي الله عنه قال حدثني احمد بن محمد العاصمي عن علي بن الحسن الميثمي عن الحسن بن علي بن يوسف عن مثني بن الوليد عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام : انه سيل عن رجل اوصي الي رجل بولده و مال لهم و اذن له عند الوصيه ان يعمل بالمال و يكون الربح بينه و بينهم فقال "لا باس به من اجل ان اباه قد اذن له في ذلك و هو حي".
en:
Hadith.5538 - Muhammad ibn Ya'qub Al-Kulayni, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad Al-'Asimi from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Mithami from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from Mathanna ibn Al-Walid from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdullah (as), who was asked about a man who appointed another man as the guardian over his children and their wealth. He also permitted him, in his will, to invest the wealth with the profit being shared between him and the children.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that because their father had granted him permission to do so while he was alive."
