en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Jafar ibn Bashir Al-Bajali has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir Al-Bajali.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Hafs Ibn Ghayath
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حفص بن غياث فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن ابيه, عن حفص بن غياث. و رويته عن علي بن احمد بن موسي- رحمه الله- عن محمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن محمد بن ابي بشير قال: حدثنا الحسين بن الهيثم قال: حدثنا سليمان بن داود المنقري, عن حفص بن غياث. و رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن القاسم بن محمد الاصبهاني, عن سليمان بن داود المنقري, عن حفص بن غياث النخعي القاضي .
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Hafs ibn Ghayath has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghayath.
I have also narrated it from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Abi Bashir, who said: Al-Husayn ibn Al-Haytham narrated to us, saying: Sulayman ibn Dawud Al-Munqari narrated to us, from Hafs ibn Ghayath.
Additionally, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Isfahani, from Sulayman ibn Dawud Al-Munqari, from Hafs ibn Ghayath Al-Nakha'i, the judge (qadi).

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn ri'ab
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن رياب فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رحمهما الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و الحميري, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن علي بن رياب .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to zur'ah From sama'ah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن زرعه, عن سماعه فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسين بن سعيد, عن اخيه الحسن, عن زرعه بن محمد الحضرمي, عن سماعه بن مهران .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Said, from his brother Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah ibn Muhammad Al-Hadrami, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abd Al-Rahman Ibn Kathir Al-Hashimi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الرحمن بن كثير الهاشمي فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن علي بن حسان الواسطي عن عمه عبد الرحمن بن كثير الهاشمي.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Kathir Al-Hashimi has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Hassan Al-Wasiti, from his uncle Abd Al-Rahman ibn Kathir Al-Hashimi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Sulayman Al-Daylami
ar: و ما كان فيه عن سليمان الديلمي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رحمهما الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن عباد بن سليمان, عن محمد بن سليمان, عن ابيه سليمان الديلمي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Sulayman Al-Daylami has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father Sulayman Al-Daylami.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Al-Fadl Al-Wasiti
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن الفضل الواسطي فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن علي بن الفضل الواسطي صاحب الرضا عليه السلام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Al-Fadl Al-Wasiti has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Al-Fadl Al-Wasiti, the companion of Imam Al-Ridha (as).

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Musa Ibn Al-Qasim Al-Bajali
ar: و ما كان فيه عن موسي بن القاسم البجلي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن الفضل بن عامر; و احمد بن محمد بن عيسي عن موسي بن القاسم البجلي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musa ibn Al-Qasim Al-Bajali has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Al-Fadl ibn 'Amir and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Musa ibn Al-Qasim Al-Bajali.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Yunus Ibn 'ammar
ar: و ما كان فيه عن يونس بن عمار فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن مالك بن عطيه, عن ابي الحسن يونس بن عمار بن الفيض الصيرفي التغلبي الكوفي و هو اخو اسحاق بن عمار.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yunus ibn 'Ammar has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn 'Atiyyah, from Abu Al-Hasan Yunus ibn 'Ammar ibn Al-Fayd Al-Sayrafi Al-Taghlibi Al-Kufi, who was the brother of Ishaq ibn 'Ammar.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Ahmad Ibn Yahya Ibn Imran Al-Ashari
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن احمد بن يحيي بن عمران الاشعري فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رحمهما الله- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار; و احمد بن ادريس جميعا عن محمد بن احمد بن يحيي بن عمران الاشعري .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran Al-Ashari has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on them both - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar and Ahmad ibn Idris together, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran Al-Ashari.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Harun Ibn Kharjah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن هارون بن خارجه فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن محمد بن علي الكوفي, عن عثمان بن عيسي, عن هارون بن خارجه الكوفي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Harun ibn Kharjah has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Harun ibn Kharjah Al-Kufi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Khalid Al-Qasri
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن خالد القسري فقد رويته عن جعفر بن محمد بن مسرور- رحمه الله- عن الحسين بن محمد بن عامر, عن عمه عبد الله بن عامر, عن حفصه, عن محمد بن خالد بن عبد الله البجلي القسري و هو كوفي عربي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Qasri has been transmitted by me from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Hafsah, from Muhammad ibn Khalid ibn Abdullah Al-Bajali Al-Qasri, who was an Arab from Kufa.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Mubarak Al-Aqraqufi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن مبارك العقرقوفي فقد رويته عن الحسين بن ابراهيم بن تاتانه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن سنان, عن مبارك العقرقوفي الاسدي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Mubarak Al-Aqraqufi has been transmitted by me from Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Mubarak Al-Aqraqufi Al-Asadi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Al-Husayn Muhammad Ibn Jafar Al-Asadi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي الحسين محمد بن جعفر الاسدي- رضي الله عنه- فقد رويته عن علي بن احمد بن موسي; و محمد بن احمد السناني, و الحسين بن ابراهيم بن احمد بن هشام المودب- رضي الله عنهم- عن ابي الحسين محمد بن جعفر الاسدي الكوفي- رضي الله عنه-.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abu Al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Jafar Al-Asadi - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - has been transmitted by me from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa, Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-Sanani, and Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham Al-Mu'addib - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them all - from Abu Al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Jafar Al-Asadi Al-Kufi - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdullah Ibn Abi ya'fur
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن ابي يعفور فقد رويته عن احمد بن محمد بن يحيي العطار- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن حماد بن عثمان, عن عبد الله بن ابي يعفور.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur has been transmitted by me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Amr Ibn Jami
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمرو بن جميع فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن احمد بن ادريس, عن محمد بن احمد, عن الحسن بن الحسين اللولوي, عن الحسن بن علي بن يوسف, عن معاذ الجوهري, عن عمرو بن جميع .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Amr ibn Jami has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Husayn Al-Lu'lu'i, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muadh Al-Jawhari, from Amr ibn Jami.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Marwan Ibn Muslim
ar: و ما كان فيه عن مروان بن مسلم فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد ابن يحيي العطار, عن محمد بن احمد بن يحيي, عن سهل بن زياد, عن محمد بن الحسين عن علي بن يعقوب الهاشمي, عن مروان بن مسلم .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Marwan ibn Muslim has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-'Attar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Asim Ibn Humayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عاصم بن حميد فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رحمهما الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن عبد الرحمن بن ابي نجران, عن عاصم بن حميد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Asim ibn Humayd has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Abd Al-Jabbar
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن عبد الجبار فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و الحميري; و محمد بن يحيي العطار; و احمد بن ادريس جميعا عن محمد بن عبد الجبار; و هو محمد بن ابي الصهبان .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, Al-Himyari, Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, and Ahmad ibn Idris together, from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar, who is Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Sahban.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Yaqub Ibn Shuayb
ar: و ما كان فيه عن يعقوب بن شعيب فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسن بن متيل, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن جعفر بن بشير عن حماد بن عثمان, عن يعقوب بن شعيب بن ميثم الاسدي و هو مولي كوفي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yaqub ibn Shuayb has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Hasan ibn Matil, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Yaqub ibn Shuayb ibn Maytham Al-Asadi, who was a freed servant (mawla) and a Kufan.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Durust Ibn Abi Mansur
ar: و ما كان فيه عن درست بن ابي منصور فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن علي الوشاء, عن درست بن ابي منصور الواسطي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Durust ibn Abi Mansur has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', from Durust ibn Abi Mansur Al-Wasiti.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Wahb Ibn Wahb
ar: و ما كان فيه عن وهب بن وهب فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن خالد, عن ابيه, عن ابي البختري وهب بن وهب القاضي القرشي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Wahb ibn Wahb has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abu Al-Bakhtari Wahb ibn Wahb Al-Qadi Al-Qurashi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Khadijah Salim Ibn Makram Al-Jammal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي خديجه سالم بن مكرم الجمال فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رحمه الله- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن محمد بن علي الكوفي, عن عبد الرحمن بن ابي هاشم, عن ابي خديجه سالم بن مكرم الجمال .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abu Khadijah Salim ibn Makram Al-Jammal has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Abu Khadijah Salim ibn Makram Al-Jammal.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Qasim Ibn Sulayman
ar: و ما كان فيه عن القاسم بن سليمان فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رحمه الله- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن عيسي بن عبيد, عن النضر بن سويد, عن القاسم بن سليمان .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Zakariyya Ibn Malik Al-Jufi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن زكريا بن مالك الجعفي فقد رويته عن الحسين بن احمد بن ادريس- رحمه الله- عن ابيه, عن محمد بن احمد, عن علي بن اسماعيل, عن صفوان بن يحيي, عن عبد الله بن مسكان, عن ابي العباس الفضل بن عبد الملك, عن زكريا بن مالك الجعفي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Zakariyya ibn Malik Al-Jufi has been transmitted by me from Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Miskan, from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl ibn Abdul Malik, from Zakariyya ibn Malik Al-Jufi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ammar Ibn Musa Al-Sabati
ar: كل ما كان في هذا الكتاب عن عمار بن موسي الساباطي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن بن احمد بن الوليد- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعيد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن الحسن علي بن فضال, عن عمرو بن سعيد المدايني, عن مصدق بن صدقه, عن عمار بن موسي الساباطي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Al-Walid - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sa'id ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdullah Ibn Bukayr
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن بكير فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن عبد الله ابن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال, عن عبد الله بن بكير.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abdullah ibn Bukayr has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibrahim Ibn Muhammad Al-Hamdani
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابراهيم بن محمد الهمداني فقد رويته عن احمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن ابراهيم ابن محمد الهمداني .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad Al-Hamdani has been transmitted by me from Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Jafar Al-Hamdani - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad Al-Hamdani.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Musadif
ar: و ما كان فيه عن مصادف فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رحمه الله- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن علي بن رياب, عن مصادف .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musadif has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Musadif.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Musab Ibn Yazid Al-Ansari, the Governor Appointed by Commander of the Faithful {a.s}
ar: و ما كان فيه عن مصعب بن يزيد الانصاري عامل امير المومنين عليه السلام فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن علي بن الحكم, عن ابراهيم بن عمران الشيباني, عن يونس بن ابراهيم, عن يحيي بن ابي الاشعث الكندي, عن مصعب بن يزيد الانصاري قال: استعملني امير المومنين علي بن ابي طالب عليه السلام علي اربع رساتيق المداين- و ذكر الحديث .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Musab ibn Yazid Al-Ansari, the governor appointed by Commander of the Faithful (as), has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Ibrahim ibn Imran Al-Shaybani, from Yunus ibn Ibrahim, from Yahya ibn Abi Al-Ashath Al-Kindi, from Musab ibn Yazid Al-Ansari, who said: "Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) appointed me over four districts of Al-Mada'in" - and he narrated the hadith in full.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Talhah Ibn Zayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن طلحه بن زيد فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن محمد بن يحيي الخزاز; و محمد بن سنان جميعا عن طلحه بن زيد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Talhah ibn Zayd has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khazzaz and Muhammad ibn Sinan together, from Talhah ibn Zayd.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Al-Ward
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي الورد فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن الحميري, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن علي بن رياب, عن ابي الورد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abu Al-Ward has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Al-Himyari, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Al-Ward.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Fadl Ibn Abi Qurrah Al-Samandi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الفضل بن ابي قره السمندي فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن علي بن الحسين السعدابادي, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي, عن شريف بن سابق التفليسي, عن الفضل بن ابي قره السمندي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Fadl ibn Abi Qurrah Al-Samandi has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sa'dabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from Sharif ibn Sabiq Al-Tiflisi, from Al-Fadl ibn Abi Qurrah Al-Samandi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Wassafi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الوصافي فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن ابن فضال, عن عبيد الله بن الوليد الوصافي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Wassafi has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Ubaydullah ibn Al-Walid Al-Wassafi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Walid Ibn Subayh
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الوليد بن صبيح فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن حماد بن عيسي, عن الحسين بن المختار, عن الوليد ابن صبيح .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Walid ibn Subayh has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar, from Al-Walid ibn Subayh.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Zuhri
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الزهري فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن القاسم بن محمد الاصبهاني, عن سليمان بن داود المنقري, عن سفيان بن عيينه, عن الزهري- و اسمه محمد بن مسلم بن شهاب- عن علي بن الحسين عليهما السلام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Zuhri has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Isfahani, from Sulayman ibn Dawud Al-Munqari, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Al-Zuhri - whose name is Muhammad ibn Muslim ibn Shihab - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both).

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Hasan Ibn Ali Al-washsha'
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسن بن علي الوشاء فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن الحسن بن علي الوشاء المعروف بابن بنت الياس .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha' has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', who was known as Ibn Bint Ilyas.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Ali Al-Halabi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن علي الحلبي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن; و محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنهم- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن ايوب بن نوح, عن صفوان بن يحيي, عن عبد الله بن مسكان, عن محمد بن علي الحلبي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi has been transmitted by me from my father, Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan, and Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them all - from Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Hasan Ibn Rashid
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسن بن راشد فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و احمد بن محمد بن عيسي; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن القاسم بن يحيي عن جده الحسن بن راشد. و رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن القاسم بن يحيي, عن جده الحسن بن راشد.
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Rashid has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid.
I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Aban Ibn Uthman
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابان بن عثمان فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن يعقوب بن يزيد; و ايوب بن نوح; و ابراهيم بن هاشم و محمد بن عبد الجبار كلهم عن محمد بن ابي عمير; و صفوان بن يحيي, عن ابان بن عثمان الاحمر.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Aban ibn Uthman has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, Ayyub ibn Nuh, Ibrahim ibn Hashim, and Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar - all of them from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Aban ibn Uthman Al-Ahmar.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Amr Ibn Khalid
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمرو بن خالد فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد ابن عبد الله, عن الهيثم بن ابي مسروق النهدي, عن الحسين بن علوان, عن عمرو بن خالد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Amr ibn Khalid has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi, from Al-Husayn ibn Alwan, from Amr ibn Khalid.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Mansur Ibn Yunus
ar: و ما كان فيه عن منصور بن يونس فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن علي بن حديد; و محمد بن اسماعيل ابن بزيع جميعا عن منصور بن يونس بزرج .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Mansur ibn Yunus has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Hadid and Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi together, from Mansur ibn Yunus Bazraj.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Al-Fayd Al-Taymi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن الفيض التيمي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن احمد بن ادريس, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن داود بن اسحاق الحذاء, عن محمد بن الفيض التيمي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Fayd Al-Taymi has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Dawud ibn Ishaq Al-Haddha', from Muhammad ibn Al-Fayd Al-Taymi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abd Al-mu'min Ibn Al-Qasim Al-Ansari Al-Kufi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد المومن بن القاسم الانصاري الكوفي فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحكم بن مسكين, عن ابي كهمس, عن عبد المومن بن القاسم الانصاري الكوفي عربي, و هو اخو ابي مريم عبد الغفار بن القاسم الانصاري .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abd Al-Mu'min ibn Al-Qasim Al-Ansari Al-Kufi has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam ibn Maskeen, from Abu Kahmas, from Abd Al-Mu'min ibn Al-Qasim Al-Ansari Al-Kufi, who was an Arab and the brother of Abu Maryam Abd Al-Ghaffar ibn Al-Qasim Al-Ansari.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Idris Ibn Hilal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ادريس بن هلال فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن محمد بن سنان عن ادريس بن هلال .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Idris ibn Hilal has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Idris ibn Hilal.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Qasim Ibn Urwah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن القاسم بن عروه فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن عبد الله ابن جعفر الحميري, عن هارون بن مسلم بن سعدان, عن القاسم بن عروه.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, from Harun ibn Muslim ibn Sadan, from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Qays
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن قيس فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن عبد الرحمن بن ابي نجران, عن عاصم بن حميد, عن محمد بن قيس .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Bishr Al-Nabbal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن بشير النبال فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن محمد بن سنان, عن بشير النبال .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Bishr Al-Nabbal has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Bishr Al-Nabbal.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Hakam Ibn Hakim, the Nephew of Khallad
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حكم بن حكيم ابن اخي خلاد فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن حكم بن حكيم .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Hakam ibn Hakim, the nephew of Khallad, has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hakam ibn Hakim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abd Al-Karim Ibn Amr
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الكريم بن عمرو فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي, عن عبد الكريم بن عمرو الخثعمي و لقبه كرام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abd Al-Karim ibn Amr has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Abd Al-Karim ibn Amr Al-Khathami, whose title was Karram.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Isa Ibn Abi Mansur
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عيسي بن ابي منصور فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن جعفر بن بشير, عن حماد بن عثمان, عن عيسي بن ابي منصور- و كنيته ابو صالح و هو كوفي مولي, و حدثنا محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن يعقوب ابن يزيد, عن ابن ابي عمير, عن ابراهيم بن عبد الحميد, عن عبد الله بن سنان, عن ابن ابي يعفور قال: كنت عند ابي عبد الله عليه السلام اذ اقبل عيسي بن ابي منصور فقال لي: "اذا اردت ان تنظر خيارا في الدنيا خيارا في الاخره فانظر اليه".
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Isa ibn Abi Mansur has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Isa ibn Abi Mansur, whose kunya was Abu Salih. He was a Kufan and a freed servant (mawla).
We were also narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd Al-Hamid, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Abi Yafur, who said: I was with Abu Abdullah (as) when Isa ibn Abi Mansur approached, and he (the Imam) said to me: "If you want to see the best in this world and the best in the hereafter, then look at him."

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Amr Ibn Shumr
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمرو بن شمر فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن الحسين السعدابادي, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي, عن ابيه, عن احمد بن النضر الخزاز, عن عمرو بن شمر.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Amr ibn Shumr has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sadabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Al-Nadr Al-Khazzaz, from Amr ibn Shumr.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Sulayman Ibn Amr
ar: و ما كان فيه عن سليمان بن عمرو فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي, عن احمد بن علي, عن عبد الله بن جبله, عن علي بن شجره, عن سليمان بن عمرو الاحمر.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Sulayman ibn Amr has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Jiblah, from Ali ibn Shajarah, from Sulayman ibn Amr Al-Ahmar.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abd Al-Malik Ibn Utbah Al-Hashimi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الملك بن عتبه الهاشمي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحسن بن علي ابن فضال, عن محمد بن ابي حمزه, عن عبد الملك بن عتبه الهاشمي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abd Al-Malik ibn Utbah Al-Hashimi has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abd Al-Malik ibn Utbah Al-Hashimi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Abi Hamzah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن ابي حمزه فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي, عن علي بن ابي حمزه.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Yahya Ibn Abi Al-Ala
ar: و ما كان فيه عن يحيي بن ابي العلاء فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسين بن الحسن بن ابان, عن الحسين بن سعيد, عن فضاله بن ايوب, عن ابان بن عثمان, عن يحيي بن ابي العلاء.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yahya ibn Abi Al-Ala has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Aban, from Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Faddalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Yahya ibn Abi Al-Ala.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Hakim
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن حكيم فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن ابيه, عن حماد بن عيسي, عن حريز عن محمد بن حكيم. و رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رحمه الله- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار عن يعقوب بن يزيد, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن محمد بن حكيم .
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Hakim has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Hakim.
I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Hakim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Al-Hakam
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن الحكم فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد ابن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن علي بن الحكم .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Al-Hakam has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Suwayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن سويد فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري جميعا عن علي بن الحكم, عن علي بن سويد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Suwayd has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari together, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Suwayd.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibrahim Ibn Abi Mahmood
ar: و ما كان فيه, عن ابراهيم بن ابي محمود فقد رويته, عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه عن ابراهيم بن ابي محمود. و رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسن بن احمد المالكي, عن ابيه, عن ابراهيم بن ابي محمود. و رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن ابراهيم بن ابي محمود.
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood.
I have also narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Hasan ibn Ahmad Al-Maliki, from his father, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood.
Additionally, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Idris Ibn Zayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ادريس بن زيد; و علي بن ادريس صاحبي الرضا عليه السلام فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن ادريس بن زيد; و علي بن ادريس, عن الرضا عليه السلام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris, the companions of Al-Ridha (as), has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Idris ibn Zayd and Ali ibn Idris, from Al-Ridha (as).

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Humran
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن حمران فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي ابن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن محمد بن حمران. و رويته ايضا عن محمد بن الحسن- رحمه الله- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن ايوب بن نوح; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن صفوان بن يحيي; و ابن ابي عمير جميعا عن محمد بن حمران .
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Humran has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Humran.
I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ibn Abi Umayr together, from Muhammad ibn Humran.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Said Al-Naqqash
ar: و ما كان فيه عن سعيد النقاش فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن الحسين السعدابادي, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي عن ابيه, عن محمد بن سنان, عن سعيد النقاش .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Said Al-Naqqash has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sadabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Said Al-Naqqash.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Qasim Ibn Yahya
ar: و ما كان فيه عن القاسم بن يحيي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و الحميري جميعا عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن القاسم بن يحيي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sad ibn Abdullah and Al-Himyari together, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Husayn Ibn Said
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسين بن سعيد فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسين بن الحسن بن ابان, عن الحسين بن سعيد. و رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسين بن سعيد.
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Said has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Aban, from Al-Husayn ibn Said.
I have also narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Said.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ghiyath Ibn Ibrahim
ar: و ما كان فيه عن غياث بن ابراهيم فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن محمد بن اسماعيل بن بزيع; و محمد بن يحيي الخزاز, عن غياث بن ابراهيم .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi and Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khazzaz, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Muhammad Al-Nawfali
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن محمد النوفلي فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن ابيه, عن احمد بن محمد بن خالد, عن ابيه, عن علي بن محمد النوفلي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Nawfali has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Nawfali.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdullah Ibn Latif Al-Taflisi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن لطيف التفليسي فقد رويته عن جعفر بن محمد بن مسرور- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسين بن محمد بن عامر, عن عمه عبد الله بن عامر, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن عبد الله بن لطيف التفليسي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi has been transmitted by me from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Latif Al-Taflisi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibn Abi Najran
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابن ابي نجران فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد ابن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن عبد الرحمن بن ابي نجران .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ibn Abi Najran has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Al-Qasim Ibn Al-Fudayl Al-Basri, Companion of Al-Ridha {a.s}
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن القاسم بن الفضيل البصري صاحب الرضا عليه السلام فقد رويته عن الحسين بن ابراهيم- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن عمرو بن عثمان, عن محمد بن القاسم بن الفضيل البصري .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl Al-Basri, the companion of Al-Ridha (as), has been transmitted by me from Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl Al-Basri.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Hanan Ibn Sudayr
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حنان بن سدير فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري جميعا عن محمد بن عيسي بن عبيد, عن حنان. و رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن عبد الصمد بن محمد, عن حنان. و رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن حنان بن سدير.
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Hanan ibn Sudayr has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari together, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Hanan.
I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Abdul-Samad ibn Muhammad, from Hanan.
Additionally, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Hanan ibn Sudayr.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Sayf Ibn Umayrah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن سيف بن عميره فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن علي بن سيف, عن اخيه الحسين [بن سيف ] عن ابيه سيف بن عميره النخعي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Sayf ibn Umayrah has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Sayf, from his brother Al-Husayn [ibn Sayf] from their father Sayf ibn Umayrah Al-Nakhai.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Isa
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن عيسي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد ابن عبد الله, عن محمد بن عيسي بن عبيد اليقطيني. و رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن عيسي بن عبيد اليقطيني .
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd Al-Yaqtini.
I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd Al-Yaqtini.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Masud Al-Ayyashi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن مسعود العياشي فقد رويته عن المظفر بن جعفر بن المظفر العلوي- رضي الله عنه- عن جعفر بن محمد بن مسعود, عن ابيه ابي النضر محمد ابن مسعود العياشي- رضي الله عنه-.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Masud Al-Ayyashi has been transmitted by me from Al-Muzaffar ibn Jafar ibn Al-Muzaffar Al-Alawi - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masud, from his father, Abu Al-Nadr Muhammad ibn Masud Al-Ayyashi - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Maymun Ibn Mihran
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ميمون بن مهران فقد رويته عن احمد بن محمد بن يحيي العطار- رضي الله عنه- عن ابيه, عن جعفر بن محمد بن مالك, عن ابي يحيي الاهوازي عن محمد بن جمهور, عن الحسين بن المختار بياع الاكفان, عن ميمون بن مهران .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Maymun ibn Mihran has been transmitted by me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his father, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Malik, from Abu Yahya Al-Ahwazi, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar, the seller of shrouds, from Maymun ibn Mihran.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Imran Al-Ajali
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن عمران العجلي فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن محمد بن عمران العجلي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Imran Al-Ajali has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Imran Al-Ajali.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Isa Ibn Abdullah Al-Hashimi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عيسي بن عبد الله الهاشمي فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن محمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن عيسي بن عبد الله بن علي بن عمر بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن ابي طالب عليهم السلام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Isa ibn Abdullah Al-Hashimi has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Isa ibn Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib - peace be upon them.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Hammam Ismail Ibn Hammam
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي همام اسماعيل بن همام فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري جميعا عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن ابي همام اسماعيل بن همام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abu Hammam Ismail ibn Hammam has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, all from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim, all from Abu Hammam Ismail ibn Hammam.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Isa Ibn Yunus
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عيسي بن يونس فقد رويته عن احمد بن محمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن سنان, عن حماد بن عثمان, عن عيسي بن يونس .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Isa ibn Yunus has been transmitted by me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Jafar Al-Hamdani - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Isa ibn Yunus.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Hudhayfah Ibn Mansur
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حذيفه بن منصور فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن محمد بن سنان, عن حذيفه بن منصور.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Dawud Al-Raqqi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن داود الرقي فقد رويته عن الحسين بن احمد بن ادريس- رضي الله عنه- عن ابيه, عن محمد بن احمد بن عبد الله بن احمد الرازي, عن حريز ابن صالح, عن اسماعيل بن مهران, عن زكريا بن ادم, عن داود بن كثير الرقي و روي عن الصادق عليه السلام انه قال: "انزلوا داود الرقي مني بمنزله المقداد من رسول الله صلي الله عليه و اله".
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Dawud Al-Raqqi has been transmitted by me from Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad Al-Razi, from Hariz ibn Salih, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Zakariyya ibn Adam, from Dawud ibn Kathir Al-Raqqi. It has been narrated from Al-Sadiq - peace be upon him - that he said: "Place Dawud Al-Raqqi in the same position with me as Al-Miqdad was with the Messenger of Allah (swt) - peace and blessings be upon him and his family."

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Al-nu'man
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن النعمان فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير; و الحسن بن محبوب جميعا عن محمد بن النعمان .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Nu'man has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr and Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub together, from Muhammad ibn Al-Nu'man.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ishaq Ibn Burayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن اسحاق بن بريد فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن الحسين السعدابادي, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي, عن المثني بن الوليد, عن اسحاق بن بريد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ishaq ibn Burayd has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sadabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Al-Muthanna ibn Al-Walid, from Ishaq ibn Burayd.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibrahim Ibn Umar
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابراهيم بن عمر فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن يعقوب بن يزيد, عن حماد بن عيسي, عن ابراهيم بن عمر اليماني .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ibrahim ibn Umar has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar Al-Yamani.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Hasan Ibn Ali Ibn Faddal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Nadr Ibn Suwayd
ar: و ما كان فيه عن النضر بن سويد فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن عيسي بن عبيد, عن النضر بن سويد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Shihab Ibn Abd Rabbih
ar: و ما كان فيه عن شهاب بن عبد ربه فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن شهاب بن عبد ربه .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسن الصيقل فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن الحسين السعدابادي, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي عن ابيه, عن يونس بن عبد الرحمن, عن الحسن بن زياد الصيقل الكوفي, و كنيته ابو الوليد و هو مولي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sadabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman, from Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad Al-Sayqal Al-Kufi, whose kunyah is Abu Al-Walid, and he was a mawla.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Amr Ibn Abi Al-Miqdam
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمرو بن ابي المقدام فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحكم ابن مسكين قال: حدثني عمرو بن ابي المقدام, و اسم ابي المقدام ثابت بن هرمز الحداد.
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Amr ibn Abi Al-Miqdam has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam ibn Maskeen, who said: Amr ibn Abi Al-Miqdam narrated to me, and the name of Abi Al-Miqdam is Thabit ibn Hurmaz Al-Haddad.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibrahim Ibn Abi Yahya Al-mada'ini
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابراهيم بن ابي يحيي المدايني فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن عبد الجبار, عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال, عن ظريف بن ناصح, عن ابراهيم بن ابي يحيي المدايني .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya Al-Mada'ini has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Zharif ibn Nasih, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya Al-Mada'ini.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdul Malik Bin a'yan
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الملك بن اعين فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن احمد بن ابي عبد الله, عن ابيه, عن يونس بن عبد الرحمن, عن عبد الملك بن اعين و كنيته ابو ضريس, و زار الصادق عليه السلام قبره بالمدينه مع اصحابه .
en: And whatever is narrated from Abdul Malik bin A'yan, I have narrated it from Muhammad bin Ali Majilwayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his uncle Muhammad bin Abi Al-Qasim, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Yunus bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdul Malik bin A'yan, whose kunyah is Abu Daris. Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), visited his grave in Medina with his companions.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Bin Asbat
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن اسباط فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن علي بن اسباط.
en: And whatever is narrated from Ali bin Asbat, I have narrated it from Muhammad bin Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Ali bin Asbat.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Al-Azz Al-Nakhkhas
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي الاعز النخاس فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن يحيي العطار, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن صفوان بن يحيي; و محمد بن ابي عمير, عن ابي الاعز النخاس .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Abu Al-Azz Al-Nakhkhas has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Al-Azz Al-Nakhkhas.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Al-rabi' Al-Shami
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي الربيع الشامي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحكم بن مسكين, عن الحسن بن رباط, عن ابي الربيع الشامي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd bin 'Abdullah, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam bin Miskin, from Al-Hasan bin Ribaat, from Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ammar Bin Marwan Al-Kalbi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمار بن مروان الكلبي فقد رويته عن محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنه- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب عن الحسن بن محبوب, عن ابي ايوب الخزار, عن عمار بن مروان .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ammar bin Marwan Al-Kalbi, I have narrated it from Muhammad bin Musa bin Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Abdullah bin Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hasan bin Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzar, from Ammar bin Marwan.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Bakr Bin Salih
ar: و ما كان فيه عن بكر بن صالح فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن بكر بن صالح الرازي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Bakr bin Salih, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, from his father, from Bakr bin Salih Al-Razi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ayyub Bin a'yan
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ايوب بن اعين فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن الحكم بن مسكين, عن ايوب بن اعين .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ayyub bin A'yan, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam bin Miskin, from Ayyub bin A'yan.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Mundhir Ibn Jafar
ar: و ما كان فيه عن منذر بن جيفر فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد ابن يحيي العطار, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن عبد الله بن المغيره, عن منذر بن جيفر.
en: And whatever is narrated from Mundhir ibn Jafar, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira, from Mundhir ibn Jafar.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdullah Bin Maymun
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن ميمون فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن عبد الله بن ميمون. و رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل; و محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنهم- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن عبد الله بن ميمون القداح المكي .
en:
And whatever is narrated from Abdullah bin Maymun, I have narrated it from my father and Muhammad bin Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Abdullah bin Maymun.
And I have also narrated it from my father, and from Muhammad bin Musa bin Al-Mutawakkil, and from Muhammad bin Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah bin Maymun Al-Qaddah Al-Makki.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Jafar Bin Al-Qasim
ar: و ما كان فيه عن جعفر بن القاسم فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و محمد بن يحيي; و احمد بن ادريس جميعا عن احمد بن ابي- عبد الله, عن ابيه, عن جعفر بن القاسم .
en: And whatever is narrated from Jafar bin Al-Qasim, I have narrated it from my father and from Muhammad bin Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Sad bin Abdullah, and from Muhammad bin Yahya, and from Ahmad bin Idris, all from Ahmad bin Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Jafar bin Al-Qasim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Mansur Al-Sayqal
ar: و ما كان فيه عن منصور الصيقل فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن عبد الجبار, عن ابي محمد الذهلي, عن ابراهيم بن خالد العطار عن محمد بن منصور الصيقل, عن ابيه منصور الصيقل .
en: And whatever is narrated from Mansur Al-Sayqal, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad bin Abdullah, from Muhammad bin Abd Al-Jabbar, from Abu Muhammad Al-Dhahili, from Ibrahim bin Khalid Al-Attar, from Muhammad bin Mansur Al-Sayqal, from his father Mansur Al-Sayqal.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Maysarah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن ميسره فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن علي الوشاء, عن علي بن ميسره.
en: And whatever is narrated from Ali ibn Maysarah, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', from Ali ibn Maysarah.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Al-Qasim Al-Astarabadi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن محمد بن القاسم الاسترابادي فقد رويته عنه .
en: And whatever is narrated from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim Al-Astarabadi, I have narrated it from him.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain for What Imam Al-Ridha {a.s} Wrote to Muhammad Ibn Sinan in Response to His Questions on Causes (reasons)
ar: و ما كان فيه مما كتبه الرضا عليه السلام الي محمد بن سنان فيما كتب من جواب مسايله في العلل فقد رويته عن علي بن احمد بن موسي الدقاق; و محمد بن احمد السناني و الحسين بن ابراهيم بن احمد بن هشام المكتب- رضي الله عنهم- قالوا: حدثنا محمد بن ابي عبد الله الكوفي قال: حدثنا محمد بن اسماعيل البرمكي, عن علي بن العباس قال: حدثنا القاسم بن الربيع الصحاف, عن محمد بن سنان عن الرضا عليه السلام .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from what Imam Al-Ridha (as) wrote to Muhammad ibn Sinan in response to his questions on causes has been transmitted by me from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa Al-Daqqaq, Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-Sinani, and Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham Al-Maktab - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them all - who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Kufi narrated to us, who said: Muhammad ibn Isma'il Al-Barmaki narrated to us, from Ali ibn Al-Abbas, who said: Al-Qasim ibn Al-Rabi' Al-Sahhaf narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Imam Al-Ridha (as).

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Hammad Al-nawwa'
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حماد النواء فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن خالد البرقي, عن محمد بن سنان, عن ابن مسكان, عن حماد النواء.
en: And whatever is narrated from Hammad Al-Nawwa', I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Barqi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Hammad Al-Nawwa'.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Khalid Ibn Abi Al-ala' Al-Khuffaf
ar: و ما كان فيه عن خالد بن ابي العلاء الخفاف فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن يعقوب بن يزيد, عن محمد بن ابي- عمير, عن خالد بن ابي العلاء الخفاف .
en: And whatever is narrated from Khalid ibn Abi Al-Ala' Al-Khuffaf, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Khalid ibn Abi Al-Ala' Al-Khuffaf.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Kahili
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الكاهلي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي, عن عبد الله ابن يحيي الكاهلي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Al-Kahili, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Abdullah ibn Yahya Al-Kahili.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ismail Ibn Al-Fadl
ar: و ما كان فيه عن اسماعيل بن الفضل فقد رويته عن جعفر بن محمد بن مسرور- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسين بن محمد بن عامر, عن عمه عبد الله بن عامر, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن عبد الرحمن بن محمد, عن الفضل بن اسماعيل بن الفضل, عن ابيه اسماعيل ابن الفضل الهاشمي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ismail ibn Al-Fadl, I have narrated it from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Muhammad, from Al-Fadl ibn Ismail ibn Al-Fadl, from his father Ismail ibn Al-Fadl Al-Hashimi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Nahdi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي الحسن النهدي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسن بن علي الوشاء, عن ابي الحسن النهدي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Nahdi, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha', from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Nahdi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Imran Al-Halabi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمران الحلبي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن جعفر بن بشير, عن حماد بن عثمان عن عمران الحلبي, و كنيته ابو الفضل .
en: And whatever is narrated from Imran Al-Halabi, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Imran Al-Halabi, whose kunyah is Abu Al-Fadl.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Hasan Ibn Harun
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسن بن هارون فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر البزنطي, عن عبد الكريم بن عمرو, عن الحسن بن هارون .
en: And whatever is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Harun, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from Abdul-Karim ibn Amr, from Al-Hasan ibn Harun.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ibrahim Ibn Sufyan
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابراهيم بن سفيان فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن محمد بن علي الكوفي, عن محمد بن سنان عن ابراهيم بن سفيان .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ibrahim ibn Sufyan, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Ma'jilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibrahim ibn Sufyan.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Al-Husayn Ibn Salim
ar: و ما كان فيه عن الحسين بن سالم فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن عبد الله بن جبله, عن ابي عبد الله الخراساني, عن الحسين بن سالم .
en: And whatever is narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Salim, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Abdullah ibn Jiblah, from Abu Abdullah Al-Khurasani, from Al-Husayn ibn Salim.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Yusuf Al-Tatri
ar: و ما كان فيه عن يوسف الطاطري فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن محمد بن سنان, عن يوسف بن ابراهيم الطاطري .
en: And whatever is narrated from Yusuf Al-Tatri, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Yusuf ibn Ibrahim Al-Tatri.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ubaydullah Ibn Ali Al-Halabi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و الحميري جميعا عن احمد و عبد الله ابني محمد بن عيسي, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن حماد بن عثمان, عن عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي و رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن, و جعفر بن محمد بن مسرور- رضي الله عنهم- عن الحسين بن محمد بن عامر, عن عمه عبد الله بن عامر, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن حماد بن عثمان, عن عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي .
en:
Everything in this book that is narrated from Ubaydullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Al-Himyari together, from Ahmad and Abdullah, the sons of Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi.
I have also narrated it from my father, from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan, and from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them all - from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir, from his uncle Abdullah ibn 'Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Fadala Ibn Ayyub
ar: و ما كان فيه عن فضاله بن ايوب فقد رويته عن ابي- رحمه الله- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن الحسين بن سعيد, عن فضاله بن ايوب. و رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسين بن الحسن بن ابان, عن الحسين بن سعيد, عن فضاله بن ايوب .
en: And whatever is narrated from Fadala ibn Ayyub, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him -  from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayyub. And I have also narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Aban, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayyub.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Yahya Al-Azraq
ar: و ما كان فيه عن يحيي الازرق فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي ابن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن ابان بن عثمان, عن يحيي ابن حسان الازرق .
en: And whatever is narrated from Yahya Al-Azraq, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Yahya ibn Hassan Al-Azraq.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Al-Numan
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن النعمان فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي; و ابراهيم بن هاشم جميعا عن علي بن النعمان .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ali ibn Al-Numan, I have narrated it from my father and Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - through Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, and Ibrahim ibn Hashim, all from Ali ibn Al-Numan.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ahmad Ibn Muhammad Ibn Mutahhar, Companion of Abu Muhammad, Peace Be Upon Him
ar: و ما كان فيه عن احمد بن محمد بن مطهر صاحب ابي محمد عليه السلام فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنهما- عن سعد بن عبد الله; و عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري جميعا عن احمد بن محمد بن مطهر صاحب ابي محمد عليه السلام .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Mutahhar, the companion of Abu Muhammad, peace be upon him, I have narrated it from my father and Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them both - through Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, all from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Mutahhar, the companion of Abu Muhammad, peace be upon him.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abu Abdullah Al-Khurasani
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ابي عبد الله الخراساني فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابي عبد الله الخراساني .
en: And whatever is narrated from Abu Abdullah Al-Khurasani, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - through Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abu Abdullah Al-Khurasani.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Harith the Seller of Carpets
ar: و ما كان فيه عن حارث بياع الانماط فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم بن هاشم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن سنان, عن حارث بياع الانماط.
en: And whatever is narrated from Harith the seller of carpets, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - through Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Harith the seller of carpets.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Amr Ibn sa'id Al-Sabati
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عمرو بن سعيد الساباطي فقد رويته عن احمد بن محمد بن يحيي العطار- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن الحسن بن علي بن فضال عن عمرو بن سعيد الساباطي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Sabati, I have narrated it from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Attar - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Sabati.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Ali Ibn Muhammad Al-Husayni
ar: و ما كان فيه عن علي بن محمد الحصيني فقد رويته عن محمد بن علي ماجيلويه- رضي الله عنه- عن عمه محمد بن ابي القاسم, عن محمد بن علي الكوفي, عن محمد بن سنان, عن علي بن محمد الحصيني .
en: And whatever is narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Husayni, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Husayni.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Suwayd Al-qallaʾ
ar: و ما كان فيه عن سويد القلاء فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رحمه الله- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار; و الحسن بن متيل, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن علي بن النعمان, عن سويد القلاء.
en: And whatever is narrated from Suwayd Al-Qallaʾ, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) have mercy on him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar and Al-Hasan ibn Matil, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khaṭṭab, from Ali ibn Al-Nuʿman, from Suwayd Al-Qallaʾ.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muthanna Ibn Abd Al-Salam
ar: و ما كان فيه عن مثني بن عبد السلام فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن محمد بن الحسن الصفار, عن معاويه بن حكيم, عن عبد الله بن المغيره, عن مثني بن عبد السلام .
en: And whatever is narrated from Muthanna ibn Abd Al-Salam, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ṣaffar, from Muawiyah ibn Hakim, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Muthanna ibn Abd Al-Salam.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to mu'awiyah Ibn Maysarah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن معاويه بن ميسره فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن علي بن الحكم, عن معاويه ابن ميسره بن شريح القاضي .
en: Everything in this book that is narrated from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Abdullah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh Al-Qadi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Jafar Ibn Najjiyah
ar: و ما كان فيه عن جعفر بن ناجيه فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن- رضي الله عنه- عن الحسن بن متيل الدقاق, عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب, عن جعفر بن بشير البجلي, عن جعفر بن ناجيه.
en: And whatever is narrated from Jafar ibn Najjiyah, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Hasan ibn Matil Al-Daqqaq, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khaṭṭab, from Jafar ibn Bishr Al-Bajali, from Jafar ibn Najjiyah.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Dhurayh Al-Muharibi
ar: و ما كان فيه عن ذريح المحاربي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن محمد بن ابي عمير, عن ذريح بن يزيد بن محمد المحاربي, و رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن علي بن ابراهيم, عن ابيه, عن الحسن بن محبوب عن صالح بن رزين, عن ذريح .
en: And whatever is narrated from Dhurayh Al-Muharibi, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Dhurayh ibn Yazid ibn Muhammad Al-Muharibi. And I have also narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ṣalih ibn Razin, from Dhurayh.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Kulayb Al-Asadi
ar: و ما كان فيه, عن كليب الاسدي فقد رويته عن ابي- رضي الله عنه- عن سعد بن عبد الله, عن احمد بن محمد بن عيسي, عن محمد بن خالد, عن فضاله بن ايوب, عن كليب بن معاويه الاسدي الصيداوي .
en: And whatever is narrated from Kulayb Al-Asadi, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Faḍalah ibn Ayyub, from Kulayb ibn Muawiyah Al-Asadi Al-Ṣaydawi.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Abdullah Ibn Jafar Al-Himyari
ar: و ما كان فيه عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن; و محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنهم- عن عبد الله بن جعفر بن جامع الحميري .
en: And whatever is narrated from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, I have narrated it from my father, and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan, and from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Abdullah ibn Jafar ibn Jamiʿ Al-Himyari.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to Muhammad Ibn Uthman Al-Amri
ar: ما كان فيه عن محمد بن عثمان العمري- قدس الله روحه- فقد رويته عن ابي; و محمد بن الحسن; و محمد بن موسي بن المتوكل- رضي الله عنهم- عن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري, عن محمد بن عثمان العمري [قدس الله روحه ].
en: And whatever is narrated from Muhammad ibn Uthman Al-Amri - may Allah (swt) sanctify his soul - I have narrated it from my father, and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan, and from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Abdullah ibn Jafar Al-Himyari, from Muhammad ibn Uthman Al-Amri - may Allah (swt) sanctify his soul.

t: Clarification of the Transmission Chain to ṣalih Ibn Uqbah
